column1: metric-definition|指标不是一个名字，而是对哪些实体、在哪个窗口、按什么规则计数的约定。事件数和实体数必须分开；未成熟观察窗口也不等于没有发生。~A metric is a counting contract over entities, eligibility and time. Event counts differ from entity counts, and incomplete follow-up is not evidence of no event.|先定订单键与下单队列；为每单截取相同观察窗口；按不同退款订单计分子；记录取消、测试单及窗口未满的处理。改规则时同时保存旧版本和影响范围。~Choose the order key and cohort, apply equal follow-up, count distinct refunded orders and declare exclusions. Version rule changes together with their affected scope.|四笔订单 P、Q、R、S；P 两次退款，Q 一次；R、S 未退款，均已观察满十天。^事件有三次，但分子是两个订单；分母四个。^按订单退款率为 2/4=50%；事件/订单比为3/4，两者不是同一指标。~Four orders P,Q,R,S complete ten-day follow-up. P has two refunds and Q one.^There are three events but two refunded orders among four eligible orders.^Order refund rate is 50%; the 3/4 event ratio measures something else.|抽查每个分子订单能回到分母；列出每笔订单观察截止日；重算不同订单数，而不是退款表行数。~Trace numerator members to the denominator, inspect follow-up cutoffs and recompute distinct orders.|以退款月分子除下单月分母会混队列；未满观察期的订单需标记未成熟。十天只是本例约定，不是通用业务标准。~Mixing refund-month numerators with order-month denominators mixes cohorts. Ten days is an example policy, not a universal standard.

sql-joins|关联键表达实体关系，关联条件对每对行判断是否匹配。唯一键只能约束所在表；一对多连接会把左表行展开。LEFT JOIN 为无匹配左行补右侧 NULL，并不保证每个实体只占一行。~A join predicate matches pairs of rows. A unique key constrains its own table; one-to-many joins expand rows. LEFT JOIN preserves unmatched left rows with nulls but does not promise one row per entity.|先声明两表粒度并查键唯一性；预估每个键的匹配数；选择保留侧；必要时先汇总明细。区分 ON 的匹配筛选与 WHERE 的连接后筛选，用 IS NULL 检查空值。~Declare both grains, test key uniqueness and predict matches per key. Choose the preserved side and aggregate detail when needed. Distinguish ON filtering from post-join WHERE and test nulls with IS NULL.|订单 U=90、V=40；U 的明细有两行，V 没有。^直接左连接得到 U、U、V 三行；SUM(订单金额)会变成220。^先汇总明细再连接后仍两笔订单，订单总额130；WHERE 明细金额>0 会删除V，放在ON中则保留V的空匹配。~Orders U=90,V=40; U has two detail rows and V none.^A raw left join yields U,U,V and inflates the order-amount sum to 220.^Pre-aggregation retains two orders and total 130. A right-side WHERE predicate drops V; an ON predicate preserves its unmatched row.|同时核对 COUNT(*)、COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)、左表保留键及金额。对照“一对零、一对一、一对多”三种键，另测右表重复键和 NULL 键。~Check rows, distinct order keys, preserved keys and totals. Exercise zero, one and many matches, duplicate right keys and null keys.|DISTINCT 金额会误删不同订单的相同金额；普通等号不会让两个 NULL 键匹配。SQLite 演示公共 SQL 语义，生产 PostgreSQL 还要核对类型、排序规则与计划。~DISTINCT amount can remove equal amounts from different orders. Equality does not match two null keys. SQLite demonstrations cover shared SQL semantics, not PostgreSQL-specific types or plans.

aggregation|WHERE 决定哪些原行参与，GROUP BY 决定分组粒度，HAVING 再筛组。COUNT(*)数行，COUNT(列)忽略该列NULL。组内比例合并必须重新组合分子分母。~WHERE filters input rows, GROUP BY defines groups and HAVING filters groups. COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(column) excludes nulls. Combine ratios through their numerators and denominators.|先写筛选窗口和粒度，再输出每组原始计数；用汇总后的分子分母计算比例；总计行独立复算。对零分母返回未知，明确金额精度与舍入位置。~Fix window and grain, expose component counts, compute ratios from aggregated components and independently reconcile totals. Treat zero denominators as undefined and declare rounding.|A组4/25，B组6/75。^加总退款10、订单100；不能把16%和8%等权平均。^整体为10%，不是12%；若筛选至少30单的组，HAVING 后只剩B。~A has 4/25 and B 6/75.^Combine 10 refunds and 100 orders rather than averaging 16% and 8%.^Overall rate is 10%, not 12%. HAVING at least 30 orders retains only B.|把组计数和总计逐项相加；抽取一个组手算；同时验证空分组、NULL列和零分母。~Reconcile component counts, hand-check one group and test empty input, null columns and zero denominators.|平均组均值通常会错配权重；先舍入再求总会积累误差。不同数据库的整数除法和数值类型需就地核对。~Averaging group means can misweight populations; rounding before aggregation accumulates error. Check database numeric and integer-division behavior.

missing|缺记录、缺字段值与真实零对应不同的数据生成过程。均值的分母通常是有效观测数；填零会把“未知”改成“确认为零”，同时改变覆盖率和数值。~Missing records, missing values and genuine zeroes represent different processes. A mean uses observed values; zero-filling changes unknowns into asserted zeroes.|保留原字段及缺失原因；把有效性检查和缺失检查分开；先报告应有数、收到数、有效数，再按用途决定排除或插补。插补值必须标记，不能覆盖原值。~Preserve raw values and missingness reasons. Separate validity from completeness and report expected, received and valid counts before excluding or imputing. Flag imputed values.|金额15、NULL、0、45，预期应收到五行但只有四行。^有效金额三条，总额60；缺值一条，缺记录一条。^有效均值20；已收行金额覆盖率75%，记录到达率80%，两个分母不同。~Amounts are 15,NULL,0,45; five rows were expected but four arrived.^Three observed amounts sum to 60; one value and one expected record are missing.^Observed mean is 20, amount coverage 75% and record arrival 80%.|分别用原行数、有效数和预期实体数核对；将真实零加入手算；检查异常字符是否被误当缺失。~Reconcile received, valid and expected counts, include genuine zeroes in controls and distinguish invalid text from missingness.|缺失不一定随机，排除后可能偏向某类人群。插补可用于特定分析，但不能制造已经发生的实际收入或实际耗时。~Missingness can be systematic. Imputation may support a declared analysis but must not fabricate observed revenue or time.

duplicate-conflict|同键不等于重复。完全相同观测可折叠；同键不同值是冲突。先定义业务键、版本和生效时间，才能决定是否为同一实体的不同历史状态。~A shared key does not establish duplication. Identical observations may collapse; differing values conflict. Business keys, versions and effective times determine identity.|给原行编号；按实体键分组比较全部业务字段；分开登记完全重复与冲突；只按有依据的权威来源或时间规则裁决，并保留被替代行的来源。~Assign raw row IDs, compare business fields by entity key, separate exact duplicates from conflicts and resolve only through authoritative source/time rules with provenance.|行1 K金额12，行2 K金额12；行3 M金额20，行4 M金额22，无更新时间。^K可折叠，M不能凭金额大小决定。^保留K一条和M两条待查，共三条；冲突清单记原行3、4。~Rows 1/2 are K=12; rows 3/4 are M=20/22 without timestamps.^Collapse K but do not choose M by amount.^Retain three rows and log raw references 3/4 for resolution.|核对折叠前后实体键集合不变；每个删除行都能回查；在没有裁决规则的组上验证不会自动取首行。~Check that entity-key coverage is preserved and every removed row is traceable. Unresolved groups must not silently take the first row.|“最新”需可信时间及并列规则；文件位置和抓取时间不一定是业务生效顺序。冲突未决时不要发布伪精确总额。~Latest requires trustworthy time and tie rules; file order or ingestion time may not reflect business validity.

quality-rules|质量维度依用途定义：有值是完整性，符合格式/值域是有效性，相同对象跨系统一致是另一项规则。规则失败率必须使用适用实体作分母。~Quality depends on purpose: presence is completeness, conformance is validity and cross-system agreement is consistency. Failure rates use the applicable population.|把用途写成字段约束或跨行规则；明确适用条件、严重度、负责人和门槛；为每条规则准备会失败与不会失败的记录；规定修复后如何复核。~Translate intended use into field or cross-row rules, defining applicability, severity, owner and gate. Supply passing/failing examples and a recheck condition.|100笔订单中80笔需邮寄；其中4笔无邮编、另2笔格式错误。^完整性失败4/80；有效性可按76个已填值或80个适用订单计算，但必须注明定义。^报告两项规则，不能只写“质量94%”。~80 of 100 orders require shipping; four lack postcodes and two have malformed codes.^Completeness failure is 4/80; validity may use 76 populated or 80 applicable records with an explicit definition.^Report separate rules rather than one opaque quality score.|重算适用集合和失败样本，抽查被排除订单；检查规则修改是否改变分母。~Recompute applicability and failures, inspect exclusions and track denominator changes when rules change.|规则通过只说明满足约定用途，不能保证数据真实；格式正确的假地址仍可能不准确。~Rule conformance does not establish truth: a syntactically valid address can still be inaccurate.

descriptive|均值反映总量分摊，中位数反映排序中间位置；分位数描述分布的不同位置。极端值可能是真实尾部体验，也可能是测量错误，必须先调查。~The mean spreads total magnitude, the median marks the ordered middle and quantiles describe distribution positions. Extreme values can be real experiences or measurement errors.|统一单位与观测对象；排序并画出分布；同时计算样本数、均值和中位数，按用途补尾部分位数；只在有依据时修正异常并保留前后对照。~Align units and observation grain, sort/inspect the distribution and report count, mean, median and relevant tails. Correct anomalies only with evidence and preserve comparisons.|耗时3、4、5、6、42分钟。^总和60除5得到均值12；排序中间为5。^典型位置约5分钟，但一个42分钟体验被均值掩盖，不能只报5。~Durations are 3,4,5,6,42 minutes.^The sum 60 gives mean 12; the ordered middle is 5.^Typical location is 5, but report the 42-minute tail too.|手工核对排序、单位和样本数；说明分位数算法；比较含与不含已确认错误值时的结果。~Check ordering, units and count; identify the quantile convention and compare results before/after confirmed measurement corrections.|小样本分位数随算法变化；不能把所有高值删除以让图表好看，也不能把分布描述当因果解释。~Small-sample quantiles depend on convention. Do not remove inconvenient tails or turn descriptive patterns into causal claims.

sampling|目标总体是想描述的人群，抽样框是实际能接触的人群。大样本可减少随机误差，却不能自动补足漏掉的人群；非响应还可能再次改变代表性。~The target population differs from the reachable sampling frame. More observations reduce random error but do not fix coverage or non-response bias.|列出总体、框和遗漏群体；按关键差异分层并设计邀请渠道；记录抽中、响应与未响应人数；按总体份额加权，同时报告局限。~Specify target/frame/gaps, stratify meaningful groups and plan recruitment. Track selections, responses and non-response; weight by target shares with limitations.|总体A占70%、B占30%，样本中两组各50人；满意度A80%、B40%。^样本直接平均60%，总体加权0.7×80%+0.3×40%。^估计为68%，但前提是各层样本可代表各自人群。~Population shares A/B are 70/30; samples contain 50 each with satisfaction 80/40%.^The sample mean is 60%, while target weighting gives 0.7×80+0.3×40.^Estimate 68% only if each stratum represents its population.|核对层权重和为1；比较响应者与可得总体特征；列出抽样框完全未覆盖的群体。~Check weights sum to one, compare respondent/population features and disclose groups absent from the frame.|加权不能凭空恢复完全没有覆盖的人群；便利样本不应仅凭样本大就报告总体精确结论。~Weighting cannot recover wholly absent groups; a large convenience sample does not justify precise population claims.

experiment|随机分配让已知和未知因素在期望上可比，观察到的差异仍有抽样不确定性。绝对百分点变化和相对百分比变化必须分开。~Random assignment makes factors comparable in expectation, but observed effects still have uncertainty. Distinguish percentage-point and relative changes.|先定随机化单位、主指标和停止规则；检查分组比例、曝光和数据缺失；按预设窗口分析效应及区间，再调查切片和同期干扰。~Predefine randomization unit, primary outcome and stopping rule. Check allocation/exposure/missingness, analyze the planned window and uncertainty, then inspect slices and interference.|A100/1000转化，B130/1000。^A10%、B13%；绝对差3个百分点，相对提升30%。^这两个效应描述相同数据的不同尺度；是否支持推广还需不确定性与成本评估。~A converts 100/1000 and B130/1000.^Rates are 10% and13%; absolute lift is3 points and relative lift30%.^These scales describe the same observations; rollout also needs uncertainty and cost analysis.|重算有效分母与分配单位；查看组间样本比例异常；保留预先设定与事后探索的区分。~Recompute denominators/unit, check allocation imbalance and distinguish planned from post-hoc analyses.|同一用户跨组、提前反复窥视后停止或同期变更会影响推断；本课手算差值不是显著性检验。~Cross-group users, unplanned peeking/stopping and concurrent changes affect inference. Hand-calculating lift is not a significance test.

star-schema|事实表按业务事件保存可度量值，维度表描述用于筛选分组的属性。维度键在连接所用范围内必须唯一；不同事实粒度的数字不能直接混加。~Facts store measures at a declared event grain; dimensions supply descriptive attributes. Dimension join keys must be unique in scope and measures at different grains cannot be blindly added.|写一行代表什么；标出事实主键、维度外键和度量可加范围；检查维度唯一性；连接后核对事实行数和总量，再按属性分组。~Declare row grain, fact keys, dimension keys and measure additivity. Test dimension uniqueness, reconcile joins, then group by attributes.|事实L1(P1,10)、L2(P1,25)、L3(P2,15)；维表P1=食品、P2=图书。^正常按类别得到食品35、图书15。^若P1维度误重复，两条P1事实被复制，合计变85而非50。~Facts L1(P1,10),L2(P1,25),L3(P2,15); products P1=food,P2=books.^Correct category totals are35 and15.^Duplicate P1 dimensions inflate the total from50 to85.|在维表GROUP BY键检查COUNT>1；比对连接前后不同事实键数与SUM；检查慢变维度的有效期是否重叠。~Check duplicate dimension keys, distinct fact keys and totals; for slowly changing dimensions inspect overlapping validity periods.|维度属性变化可能需要历史版本键；不能只按当前属性重写历史含义。订单级费用放到明细粒度也会被重复计量。~Historical attributes may require versioned keys. Order-level costs copied to line grain can be double counted.

pivot-tables|透视表用维度字段分组，用值字段执行聚合。显示格式不会把文本变成数值，源范围、筛选、聚合方式和刷新状态共同决定结果。~Pivot dimensions define groups and value fields choose aggregation. Formatting does not convert text to numbers; range, filters, aggregation and refresh determine results.|整理一行一笔交易且表头唯一的矩形数据；核对金额类型；把地区放行、金额放值并选择求和；核对筛选和源范围，新增行后刷新。~Prepare rectangular transaction data with unique headers, verify numeric amounts, place region on rows and sum amounts. Reconcile filters/range and refresh after adding rows.|东区金额10、20，西区30；新增东区15。^旧总计60；源范围含新行且刷新后，东区45、西区30。^总计应75；若显示4，检查是否用了计数。~East has10,20 and West30; append East15.^The old total is60; an expanded, refreshed source gives East45,West30.^Expected total75; a value4 suggests count instead of sum.|在相同筛选下用SUM或手算独立对账；记录源范围和刷新步骤；检查空行、文本金额及总计规则。~Reconcile independently under identical filters, record source/refresh steps and inspect blanks, text amounts and total settings.|不同Excel版本和数据模型的界面入口不同；课堂讲字段与聚合语义，不能靠改总计单元格“修复”源数据问题。~Excel interfaces/data models vary. Learn field and aggregation semantics rather than overwriting totals to hide source problems.

chart-choice|图形编码应匹配读者的比较任务。分类大小依共享基线易于比较，时间趋势需要保留时间间隔；零和未观测值是不同含义。~Encoding should match the comparison task. Shared baselines support category comparisons; time trends need time spacing. Zero differs from missing observations.|先写读者要回答的问题；选择分类比较或时间变化；给轴单位、范围和来源；检查缺失期、基线、颜色含义及文字替代。~State the reader question, choose category or time encoding, label units/range/source and inspect missing periods, baselines, colors and text alternatives.|地区A120、B80、C100，同月；另一序列1月8%、2月缺测、3月6%。^地区用共享零基线条形图；月份用连续时间轴并在2月留缺口。^排序帮助比较，但不能把地区当作时间顺序连成趋势。~Same-month regions A120,B80,C100; monthly rates8%,missing,6%.^Use zero-baseline bars for regions and a spaced time axis with a February gap.^Sorting aids comparison but does not turn categories into a time trend.|让读者用图回答原问题；核对轴单位、分母和时间；用表格与替代文字核对颜色以外的信息。~Have readers answer the original question; check units, denominators and dates against a table and non-color cues.|截断条形基线会夸大比例；不同分母的比率不能只看柱高。教学草图不替代可访问性实测。~Truncated bar baselines distort magnitude; rates need denominator context. A sketch does not establish accessibility.

decision-brief|简报要把观察、解释和建议分开。可复算证据说明数据如何得到；限制说明结论还能有何解释；后续动作需要可观察的验收条件。~Separate observation, interpretation and recommendation. Reproducible evidence explains calculation, limitations admit alternatives and follow-up needs observable criteria.|先用一句写观察与幅度，再给范围、口径和版本；列出最重要替代解释；提出成本可控的下一步，并规定用什么结果判断。~State the change and magnitude, provide scope/definition/version, identify the main alternative explanation and propose a bounded action with evaluation criteria.|配送中位数从9到7分钟，同期增加近距离订单。^观察为下降2分钟；按距离分层复核，不能直接归因排班优化。^后续在同距离层比较，并保留原始查询和窗口。~Median delivery falls9→7 minutes while nearby orders increase.^Observe a2-minute reduction and check distance strata rather than assigning causation to staffing.^Compare like-distance groups and retain query/window provenance.|每个数字能定位到输入与步骤；每个建议有责任、期限和判断依据；把未验证原因明确标为假设。~Trace numbers to inputs/steps and actions to owners, times and criteria. Mark unverified causes as hypotheses.|标题不能比证据更强；没有对照时不声称因果。复算性与决策合理性是两种不同的审查。~A headline must not outrun evidence. Reproducibility and decision quality are distinct reviews.

task-baseline|预测任务由对象、标签、预测时间及错误代价定义。基线是可比较的简单策略，而不是随便选一个模型；预测时不可得的信息不能作为输入。~Define prediction objects, labels, prediction time and error costs. A baseline is a comparable simple strategy; unavailable-at-prediction inputs are invalid.|列出输入何时可用；定义正负标签及观察窗口；先计算多数类或规则基线；固定评估切分和指标后再比较复杂模型。~List input availability, define labels/window, calculate a majority/rule baseline and freeze evaluation splits/metrics before model comparison.|1000个样本中900个负类；多数类策略准确率90%，正类召回率0。^若业务重视漏检，90%准确率并不够。^把召回、误报成本和样本分布一起作为基线记录。~900 of1000 examples are negative; always-negative accuracy is90% and positive recall0.^A missed-positive task cannot be judged by90% accuracy alone.^Record recall, false-alarm costs and prevalence with the baseline.|确认基线和候选使用同一数据窗口、标签和指标；检查任何特征是否发生在标签结果之后。~Compare identical windows/labels/metrics and check whether a feature occurs after the outcome.|无法明确标签或使用边界时先重定任务，不把相关性代理随意当真实目标。~Redefine tasks with unclear labels/boundaries rather than quietly substituting a convenient proxy.

python-data|CSV 类型推断可能改变标识符和缺失含义。解析日期失败与原始缺失是两种质量问题；可重复准备流程应保留原输入和转换规则。~CSV inference can change identifiers and missingness. retrieval-grounding|检索命中与回答有据是两项检查。文档相似不代表支持具体主张；必须记录片段、版本和引用位置，并识别证据缺口或相互冲突。~Retrieval relevance differs from claim support. authentication|认证回答“是谁”，会话维持认证后的连续交互，授权决定“能做什么”。空闲超时、总超时与撤销是不同机制，客户端Cookie存在不代表会话仍有效。~Authentication establishes identity, sessions maintain continuity and authorization governs actions. Idle expiry, overall expiry and revocation differ; a remaining cookie proves none of them.|梳理登录、退出、找回和权限变化路径；列出会话创建、轮换、过期与撤销时点；在服务端逐请求核对有效性，保护会话秘密及CSRF边界。~Map login/logout/recovery/privilege changes and session creation/rotation/expiry/revocation. Validate server-side per request and protect session secrets/CSRF boundaries.|用户退出后另一窗口携旧Cookie请求。^服务端撤销状态应生效，返回需重新认证。^只隐藏退出按钮或清一个页面的内存不完成注销。~After logout another window sends the old cookie.^Server revocation must reject it and require authentication.^Hiding UI or clearing one window's memory is insufficient.|在多窗口、过期、重置密码和角色变化后重放合成会话；记录预期与实际，避免日志保存令牌。~Test synthetic sessions across windows, expiry, recovery and role changes without logging tokens.|不同认证保证等级有不同规范期限；本课不提供通用固定分钟数，也不把登录成功当作对象授权。~Assurance levels impose different timeout policies; this lesson gives no universal duration and does not equate login with object access.

authorization|权限检查必须绑定主体、动作与具体资源，默认拒绝未声明授权。横向越权是在同角色下访问他人对象；角色越权涉及超出职责的动作。~Authorization binds principal, action and object, denying undeclared access. Horizontal violations access peers' objects; role violations exceed assigned functions.|写权限矩阵；服务端限定租户和对象范围；所有入口复用检查；为本人、他人、受限角色及未知对象设计允许和拒绝案例。~Build an access matrix, constrain tenant/object scope server-side and reuse checks at every entry point. Test own/other/restricted/unknown objects.|用户甲可读订单A，用户乙拥有订单B。^甲把参数改成B时仍需对象检查。^返回拒绝或按契约隐藏存在性，不能仅因甲已登录而返回B。~A user owns orderA, another ownsB.^Changing a request toB still requires object authorization.^Deny or conceal existence per contract; login alone cannot allowB.|对每条路由和批量入口核对同一矩阵；检查过滤发生在取数之前或可信查询范围内。~Exercise each route/bulk entry against the matrix and ensure data retrieval respects trusted scope.|不可猜ID不是访问控制；资源创建、导出和批量查询也要单独检查。~Unguessable IDs are not access control; creation, exports and bulk queries need checks too.

secrets|凭据是授予能力的秘密，不应进入源码、普通日志或共享工单。泄漏后删除当前文件不能收回历史副本；撤销、轮换及使用者迁移需要配套。~Credentials grant capabilities and do not belong in code, routine logs or tickets. Removing a file cannot revoke leaked history; rotation needs consumer migration.|登记秘密的所有者、使用者和权限；用受控存储注入；泄漏时撤销或轮换并更新使用方；验证旧值失效、新值正常，再核对历史日志与副本。~Inventory ownership/consumers/scope, inject from controlled storage, revoke/rotate on exposure and verify old rejection/new success before reviewing historical copies.|测试密钥泄漏，服务仍持旧值。^创建替代、更新受控使用方并按策略撤销旧值。^仅重启服务不会让被盗旧密钥失效。~A leaked test key is still used by a service.^Migrate authorized consumers and revoke the old value per policy.^Restarting alone does not revoke stolen credentials.|在隔离环境用合成密钥演练轮换；检查最小权限、审计及失败回退，不把真实值写入验收。~Rehearse with synthetic keys, verify least privilege/auditing/recovery and keep real values out of evidence.|加密密钥轮换可能涉及历史数据重加密；不同秘密生命周期不同，不能统一“删掉重建”。~Encryption-key rotation may require historical re-encryption; different secret types need different lifecycles.

event-logs|事件发生时间、采集时间和显示时区不同。跨源关联需要稳定标识与时间精度；单个IP或相近时间不一定代表同一用户或事件。~Event, ingestion and display times differ. Cross-source correlation needs stable IDs and clock precision; shared IP/time alone does not establish identity.|保留原时间与时区；建立统一比较时间；按用户、会话、请求和目标关联；登记时钟偏差、缺失源和保留窗口；避免在日志暴露凭据。~Preserve raw time/zone, normalize comparison time and correlate user/session/request/target, documenting skew, gaps and retention without secrets.|09:15+08:00登录，01:16Z访问，两个日志共享会话S7。^统一UTC后相差1分钟。^可列为同一会话时间线，但是否异常还需动作及授权上下文。~A login at09:15+08 and access at01:16Z share sessionS7.^They are one minute apart in UTC.^Build a session timeline but use action/authorization context to assess abnormality.|检查转换前后日期，保留原始行号；用标识关联与时间关联相互复核。~Check date rollover, retain raw references and cross-check identifiers against time evidence.|共享出口与代理会复用IP；无日志不等于无事件，也可能是采集缺口。~NAT/proxies share IPs; absence of logs can reflect collection gaps rather than absence of events.

triage|告警是待解释的线索。分诊先评估影响和证据完整性，再比较维护、正常行为、配置错误与攻击等替代解释，不能凭一个信号直接定性。~Alerts require explanation. Triage assesses impact/evidence and compares maintenance, normal behavior, misconfiguration and attack hypotheses.|记录告警规则、版本和时间窗；核对受影响资产与已知变更；用身份、目标、动作与第二来源证据交叉检查；按风险升级并记录未知。~Capture rule/version/window, verify assets/changes, corroborate identities/actions with another source and escalate by risk while retaining unknowns.|凌晨批量登录失败，维护计划同窗存在。^核对维护使用的身份和目标是否吻合，并查成功登录与后续动作。^若目标不符，维护时间重合不能作为误报结论。~Bulk failures overlap maintenance.^Check maintenance identities/targets and subsequent successful actions.^Mismatched targets prevent dismissing the alert on timing alone.|为每个假设写支持、反对与缺失证据；确认关闭依据或升级原因可追溯。~List supporting, contradicting and missing evidence per hypothesis and retain closure/escalation rationale.|不能为了补证据自行扩大测试授权；低置信度与低影响也不是一回事。~Evidence gathering cannot expand authorization; low confidence does not imply low impact.

incident-handoff|交接要让下一位接手者区分已知事实、推断和未知，并知道正在影响谁、做过什么、哪些动作已获授权及下一次更新何时发生。~A handoff separates facts/inferences/unknowns and identifies impact, actions, authority and the next update.|整理带来源的时间线；列明影响范围和证据缺口；记录已执行动作及回执；指定负责人、升级路径和下一更新时间，保留原证据。~Build a sourced timeline, state impact/gaps, record actions/receipts and assign ownership/escalation/update time while preserving evidence.|确认主机H1异常，H2待查，已隔离H1且获负责人批准。^交接分别列确认1台、待查1台及隔离回执。^不能写成“两台已感染”或“其余全部安全”。~H1 is confirmed abnormal, H2 unexamined; authorized isolation coversH1.^Report one confirmed, one unknown and the isolation receipt.^Do not claim both infected or all others safe.|让接手者按记录重建当前状态；核对每项操作有身份、时间和依据；待办有责任人。~Have the recipient reconstruct state, checking action identity/time/authority and ownership of open work.|事件报告不等于根因复盘；敏感证据按访问范围保存，公开摘要不得泄漏秘密。~Incident reporting differs from root-cause review; restrict sensitive evidence and redact public summaries.

threat-model|威胁建模从资产与数据流分析信任边界，问谁能控制输入、可触及什么资产及控制失败的影响。它输出可验证风险，不只是组件清单。~Threat modeling analyzes assets/data flows and trust boundaries: who controls inputs, what assets are exposed and how controls can fail.|画外部实体、进程、存储和数据流；标出跨边界的身份与数据；逐流提出威胁；为每项选择缓解、验证案例与剩余风险负责人。~Diagram actors/processes/stores/flows, mark identity/data crossings, identify threats and assign mitigations, tests and residual-risk ownership.|浏览器提交user_id与订单号到服务端。^客户端可改user_id；服务端应从可信会话确定主体。^测试伪造主体和他人对象，确认不返回订单。~A browser submitsuser_id and orderID.^The client can alteruser_id; derive the principal from a trusted session.^Test forged principals and foreign objects for denial.|把每条风险连到边界、控制和反例；架构或信任关系变化时更新模型。~Trace risks to boundaries, controls and counterexamples and revise when architecture/trust changes.|图画得完整不证明控制有效；没有实际测试的缓解仍是待验证设计。~A complete diagram does not establish effective controls; untested mitigations remain design assumptions.

safe-input|输入校验约束类型、长度和业务范围；参数化查询把值与SQL结构分开。列名、排序方向等标识符通常需受控映射，不能当普通值绑定。~Validation constrains type/length/range; parameterization separates values from SQL structure. Identifiers and sort directions generally need allowlisted mapping.|先校验输入形状；查询值用驱动参数绑定；动态结构从固定映射选取；按对象权限限定查询范围；错误响应避免回显内部细节。~Validate shape, bind values, map dynamic structure through fixed choices and constrain object scope. Avoid exposing internals in errors.|输入sort=price、customer=U1。^将price映射到预定义列，将U1作为绑定值。^未知sort拒绝，不把任意字符串拼到ORDER BY中。~Input sort=price,customer=U1.^Mapprice to a predefined column and bindU1.^Reject unknown sort values rather than concatenating arbitrary ORDER BY text.|用引号、空值、越界值、未知列和他人对象测试；确认它们不会改变查询结构或扩大数据范围。~Test quotes/nulls/ranges/unknown columns/foreign objects without permitting structure or scope changes.|转义不是所有场景的首选替代；参数占位符语法依驱动而异，本课不执行真实目标请求。~Escaping is not the universal alternative; placeholder syntax is driver-specific and exercises stay offline.

verify-control|控制验证要有身份、动作、对象、前置条件和可观察预期。允许路径和拒绝路径都需要证据；某个管理员操作成功不说明普通用户被正确限制。~Control checks require identity/action/object/preconditions and observable expectations, covering both allowed and denied paths.|从控制声明写测试矩阵；固定版本和合成账号；执行正常、越权、无身份及边界输入；保留实际结果和修复后复测范围。~Translate controls into a matrix, fix version/synthetic accounts and test allowed, unauthorized, anonymous and boundary cases with results and retest scope.|要求“只有所有者能修改备注”。^用户甲修改甲对象应成功，甲修改乙对象应拒绝且内容不变。^两条都通过才覆盖这一声明。~Only owners may edit notes.^A editingA succeeds; A editingB is denied without mutation.^Both checks are needed to cover the claim.|核对拒绝时没有副作用；重试及批量接口也使用同一控制；未测项保留未知。~Check denial has no side effects, retries/bulk routes enforce the same rule and untested scope stays unknown.|测试通过只覆盖记录的版本、身份与条件，不等于全部安全；不得为验证擅自使用真实凭据。~Results cover recorded conditions, not all security; do not use real credentials without authority.

service-account|进程权限由实际运行身份、组和路径权限共同决定。读取文件既需要文件读权限，也需要逐级目录遍历权限；用管理员测试可能掩盖服务身份缺权。~Process identity, groups and path permissions jointly determine access. Reading needs file permission and directory traversal; administrator tests can hide service-user failures.|先确定进程实际用户与组；沿完整路径核对目录和文件；按所需最小读写范围配置；用相同服务身份验证，避免用宽泛管理员权限修复。~Identify runtime user/groups, inspect every path component and grant only needed access. Verify as the service identity rather than broadly elevating it.|文件/report/data.csv可读，但/report目录对服务组无遍历权限。^读文件仍失败。^修正限定目录权限后以服务身份复核，不把整个目录设为任意人可写。~The CSV is readable but/report denies traversal to the service group.^Access still fails.^Repair scoped directory permission and retest as the service user, without world-write access.|核对目录遍历、文件读取、所需写入和不应允许的路径；记录身份与实际结果。~Check traversal, file reads, necessary writes and denied paths with identity-specific results.|Linux权限、ACL、容器映射或强制访问控制可能共同生效；课堂模式位不能覆盖所有部署策略。~Mode bits, ACLs, container mappings and mandatory controls can interact; a basic permission example is not a full deployment policy.

http-diagnosis|HTTP状态码由返回它的节点产生。客户端错误、网关到上游错误和应用业务拒绝需要结合请求标识与各段日志区分，不能只凭一个码断言根因。~The responding node produces the status code. Distinguish client, gateway/upstream and app failures using request IDs and per-hop evidence.|画出请求链；记录同一请求各段状态与时间；优先找首个不满足成功条件的环节；核对超时、目标地址、监听与应用日志。~Map the chain, align per-hop status/time for one request and find the first failed condition before inspecting timeouts, targets and logs.|浏览器收到502，网关记录connect refused，上游无请求日志。^连接在到达应用前被拒。^先核对上游端口和进程，不能据此认定应用业务代码返回502。~Browser502, gatewayconnect refused, no app request.^The connection failed before the app.^Inspect upstream port/process rather than claiming app business logic returned502.|用相同请求标识串联证据，区分“没找到日志”和“已确认没有到达”；复核恢复后的真实用户路径。~Correlate request IDs, distinguish absent evidence from confirmed non-arrival and verify restored user paths.|代理可能改写状态与响应；一次成功健康检查不覆盖认证、存储和业务依赖。~Proxies can rewrite responses; one health endpoint does not cover auth, storage or business dependencies.

signal-triage|流量、延迟、错误和饱和度描述不同方面。高CPU可能是负载结果而非根因；平均延迟会掩盖尾部或错误请求，定位要关联同一时间窗的用户影响。~Traffic, latency, errors and saturation differ. CPU can be an effect; averages hide tails/errors. Correlate aligned windows with user impact.|先确认错误率和关键路径延迟；对齐变更与流量；检查瓶颈资源和排队；用对照或小范围措施检验假设，记录影响恢复而非只看资源下降。~Establish user errors/latency, align changes/load, inspect bottlenecks/queues and test hypotheses with controls, verifying user recovery.|流量翻倍，CPU80%，错误率从1%到6%，p95由200到900ms。^先看错误与尾延迟，再查队列和下游。^CPU高只是候选线索，不能立即认定加CPU就会恢复。~Traffic doubles, CPU80%, errors1→6%,p95 200→900ms.^Inspect errors/tails, queues and downstreams.^CPU alone does not prove more CPU fixes it.|比较同窗口分子分母，分版本或节点切片；措施后复查错误、延迟及流量是否同时恢复。~Align denominators/windows, slice by version/node and recheck user errors, latency and traffic after intervention.|指标采样、聚合粒度和负载构成会影响判断；不能把相关先后直接当因果。~Sampling, aggregation and workload mix affect interpretation; temporal association alone is not causation.

container-build|镜像是分层构建产物，构建上下文决定可被复制的文件。后层删除秘密不保证旧层没有它；运行时配置与构建内容应分开。~Images are layered artifacts and build context controls available files. Later deletion does not erase earlier secrets; separate build content from runtime configuration.|缩小上下文并使用忽略规则；固定基础与依赖；分阶段构建；在受控机制注入秘密；以非必要写权限最小的运行身份启动，并记录镜像摘要。~Minimize/ignore context, pin bases/dependencies, use staged builds and controlled secrets, then run least-privileged and retain image digests.|构建目录含.env与源码；COPY . 会把两者一起送入镜像。^在上下文排除秘密并调整复制路径。^检查构建历史及产物，不依赖后续RUN rm .env。~A build context contains.env and code; COPY . includes both.^Exclude secrets and narrow copy paths.^Inspect history/artifacts rather than relying on later deletion.|在隔离构建中检查文件清单、依赖、入口和摘要；用合成秘密验证其不进入层和日志。~Inspect files/dependencies/entrypoint/digest and use synthetic secrets to check layers/logs.|标签可移动，摘要才指向具体内容；容器隔离不自动赋予应用最小权限或数据备份能力。~Tags can move; digests identify content. Containers do not automatically provide least privilege or backups.

deployment-health|就绪表示实例可接流量，存活决定是否需要重启，启动探针为长初始化提供独立保护。将依赖短暂故障当存活失败可能造成重启雪崩。~Readiness controls traffic, liveness may trigger restart and startup probes protect long initialization. Dependency outages used as liveness signals can cause restart cascades.|定义用户路径成功条件；分别设计启动、就绪和存活检查；配置容忍次数与时间；演练未就绪、卡死及依赖故障；滚动期间核对可用副本。~Define user readiness, separate probe purposes, configure timing/tolerance and rehearse initializing, stuck and dependency-failure cases while tracking available replicas.|应用需45秒预热，依赖短暂不可用。^启动期间由startup保护；未就绪不接流量。^不应因暂时外部依赖失败就不断重启所有健康进程。~An app warms for45 seconds and a dependency briefly fails.^Use startup protection and remove unready traffic.^Do not repeatedly restart healthy processes for transient external failures.|观察流量资格、重启次数和关键路径，验证每种探针失败只触发约定行为。~Observe routing eligibility, restart counts and critical paths; verify each failure has its intended effect.|探针字段和特性按Kubernetes版本核对；HTTP200只检查被定义的路径，不代表整套业务可用。~Check Kubernetes-version fields/features; HTTP200 covers its defined probe, not the entire business workflow.

infra-state|基础设施状态把配置资源映射到真实对象，可能含敏感值。计划差异是一份拟执行变化，不是安全批准，尤其删除、替换与共享状态冲突需审查。~State maps configured resources to real objects and may contain secrets. A plan proposes changes, not approval; review deletion, replacement and shared-state conflicts.|固定配置与provider版本；获取计划并逐项解释增改删；控制远程状态访问及锁；批准后按同一计划执行，并核对实际资源与漂移。~Pin configuration/providers, explain plan changes, protect/lock shared state, apply the approved plan and reconcile resources/drift.|计划把数据库标为replace，因为实例标识变化。^先核对是否预期以及数据迁移/恢复条件。^计划生成成功不等于允许销毁旧库。~A changed identifier plans database replacement.^Verify intent and migration/recovery prerequisites.^A successful plan does not authorize destruction.|对照资源身份、删除清单与依赖；检查状态锁、备份和执行者；应用后复核而非只看退出码。~Review resource identities/deletions/dependencies, state locks/backups/actors and post-apply state.|不直接手改共享state修复业务数据；课堂只评审合成计划，不执行真实基础设施变更。~Do not hand-edit shared state as a business-data fix; these exercises review synthetic plans only.

four-signals|四个黄金信号分别回答需求规模、响应速度、失败比例与资源余量。告警应关联需要人采取动作的用户影响，而不是每个资源尖峰都叫醒人。~Golden signals describe demand, speed, failure and capacity. Alerts should require actionable response to user impact, not every resource spike.|为关键路径定义信号和分母；区分成功/失败请求延迟；选择时间窗、门槛与持续条件；给告警附负责人与排查入口。~Define signals/denominators per critical path, separate successful/failed latency and choose windows/thresholds/duration with owners and runbooks.|CPU短升90%但错误和延迟正常；另一窗口CPU低但错误8%。^前者需观察容量，后者直接影响用户。^告警优先级取决于影响和行动，而非CPU排名。~CPU briefly90% with normal errors/latency; another window has lowCPU but8% errors.^The former suggests capacity review, the latter immediate user impact.^Prioritize impact/action, not CPU ranking.|检查是否会漏报真实故障、是否有无行动噪声；用历史窗口回放门槛并确认分母一致。~Replay fault/normal windows, inspect missed incidents and non-actionable noise and verify denominators.|“四信号齐全”不代表覆盖所有业务风险；低流量服务还要防小分母造成误读。~Having four metrics does not cover every risk; low traffic needs small-denominator care.

slo-budget|SLI把“好事件/有效事件”量化，SLO设定目标。误差预算是目标允许的坏事件空间，并非承诺可以故意制造故障；窗口和排除规则必须明确。~An SLI quantifies good/eligible events and an SLO sets its objective. Error budget is allowed bad-event space, not permission to create failures; define windows/exclusions.|定义好坏事件与有效分母；选窗口与目标；计算允许坏事件和已消耗量；制定预算消耗后的发布、恢复与批准策略。~Define events/eligibility/window/target, compute allowed/consumed bad events and establish budget policies for release, recovery and approval.|窗口10000次，SLO99.9%，已失败6次。^允许10个坏事件，尚余4个。^若下一次故障再失败8次，将超预算4，不是“仍有99%以上就没事”。~10000 events,99.9% SLO,6 failures.^Allowance10, remaining4.^Eight more failures exceed budget by4 despite overall success above99%.|独立复算分子分母、窗口和排除项；同时报告用户影响与预算消耗速度。~Recompute events/window/exclusions and report user impact and burn rate.|按请求与按时间定义的预算不可直接混用；教学算式不替代完整可靠性政策。~Request- and time-based budgets are not interchangeable; arithmetic does not replace reliability policy.

telemetry|指标聚合发现何时和多大范围异常，追踪串联一次请求的调用，日志补充事件细节。跨服务关联依赖传播的上下文与采集完整性。~Metrics reveal timing/scope, traces link request calls and logs explain events. Correlation depends on context propagation and collection coverage.|从异常指标选窗口；定位相应trace；沿span查慢段或失败依赖；用trace/request标识查日志；记录采样和时钟限制，过滤敏感字段。~Select a metric window, inspect traces/spans and correlated logs, documenting sampling/clock limits and filtering sensitive values.|请求总耗时500ms，两个串行span分别40与420ms。^先检查420ms的依赖段及其日志。^总时长并非必然等于span简单和，仍可能有未采集区间或并行段。~A500ms request has serial40ms and420ms spans.^Inspect the420ms dependency/logs first.^Missing intervals and parallelism mean span sums need interpretation.|核对上下文是否跨边界传播；比较采样请求与总体；验证日志字段不会泄漏令牌。~Check propagation, sampling representativeness and log redaction.|未看到trace可能是未采样而非未发生；不能把服务时钟偏差误认作因果顺序。~A missing trace may be unsampled; clock skew can mislead causal ordering.

canary-gate|灰度以有限暴露比较候选和稳定版本。代表性流量、时间窗、样本量与可归因指标决定判断质量；全局平均会稀释小灰度故障。~Canaries compare candidate/control under limited exposure. Representativeness, windows, volume and attributable metrics determine validity; global averages dilute failures.|预设流量范围、错误/延迟门槛和停止动作；按版本分组同窗比较；先小范围再扩展；门槛失败立即按授权暂停并保存证据。~Predefine exposure, error/latency gates and stop actions, compare version-specific aligned windows and expand gradually with evidence-backed pauses.|候选100次错10次，对照900次错9次。^候选10%、对照1%，全局1.9%会掩盖差距。^应按版本门槛判断，不能只看总图低于2%。~Candidate10/100 errors, control9/900.^Rates10% versus1%; global1.9% hides the gap.^Apply version-specific gates rather than a global2% chart.|核对样本和时间窗，确认业务分布可比；同时检查延迟、错误与回退后恢复。~Check counts/windows/workload comparability and errors, latency and post-rollback recovery.|小样本未超门槛不代表安全；共用依赖可能污染对照，长周期指标不适合短灰度直接对比。~Small samples do not establish safety; shared dependencies contaminate controls and long metric windows can mislead short canaries.

rollback-verify|回退恢复的是代码/配置版本，不一定恢复数据与用户状态。恢复验收需确认兼容性、关键路径及稳定观察，而非命令成功即可结束。~Rollback restores a code/configuration version, not necessarily data/user state. Verify compatibility, critical paths and stability beyond command success.|记录回退目标与前置条件；确认数据库及消息兼容；按计划执行；核对实际版本和用户路径；观察指标后再宣布恢复并安排补偿。~Identify target/prerequisites, check database/message compatibility, execute and verify actual version/user paths, then observe metrics and plan compensation.|新版本写入旧版不识别的字段含义。^仅切旧二进制可能继续失败。^先确认兼容或恢复方案，再验证登录、读写和历史记录。~A new release writes semantics the old version cannot understand.^Switching binaries alone may fail.^Establish compatibility/recovery and verify login, reads/writes and history.|比对版本摘要；验证关键数据和端到端动作；记录观察窗口与未恢复范围。~Check artifact digests, data and end-to-end actions with observation windows and remaining gaps.|不在未确认路径上自动回退数据库；本课用计划与合成日志，不对生产执行恢复。~Do not automatically roll back databases without a validated plan; exercises use synthetic plans/logs.

incident-review|复盘关注系统如何让故障发生与扩大，避免把“谁犯错”代替可验证原因。时间线、影响和行动项应区分证据、推断及待验证假设。~Reviews examine how systems enabled/amplified incidents rather than substituting blame for evidence. Separate timeline, impact, hypotheses and verifiable actions.|收集时间线与影响；识别触发、放大及检测恢复条件；为改进项指定负责人、期限和验证；跟踪完成证据并回查是否减少同类风险。~Assemble impact/timeline, distinguish triggers/amplifiers/detection/recovery and assign actions with owners, dates and tests, tracking their effect.|变更后队列积压，告警30分钟后才触发。^分别评估变更缺陷与检测延迟。^改进项写“增加队列年龄门槛并演练”，而不是“加强责任心”。~A change causes queue buildup; alerts arrive30 minutes late.^Analyze both defect and detection delay.^Specify a queue-age gate and rehearsal, not vague demands for more care.|每个结论指向日志或访谈依据；行动能用演练、测试或指标验证；明确尚未确认的因果。~Trace conclusions to evidence and actions to tests/rehearsals/metrics, retaining uncertain causes.|无责不等于无责任，改进仍需明确所有者；一个复盘不覆盖所有未来故障。~Blameless review still needs accountable action owners; one review is not exhaustive prevention.

semantic-html|HTML元素首先表达含义和交互契约。链接用于导航，按钮用于动作，表单字段需要可访问名称。原生元素提供键盘与语义基础，视觉样式不能代替这些行为。~HTML conveys meaning and interaction contracts. Links navigate, buttons act and form controls need accessible names. Styling cannot replace native semantics/keyboard behavior.|先按内容结构选标题、列表、表格和表单；用label关联字段；动作使用明确type的button；核对名称、键盘与提交行为，再加样式。~Choose structural elements, associate labels, give buttons explicit types and verify names, keyboard and submission before styling.|form内有input id=email和label for=email，保存button type=submit，帮助button type=button。^点击标签聚焦输入；帮助不会意外提交。^移除for关联或遗漏button类型，可能破坏名称或触发误提交。~A form linkslabel toemail, with submit/save and button/help.^The label focuses the field and help does not submit.^Missing association/type can break naming or trigger unintended submission.|用键盘操作、可访问名称检查及HTML验证核对；检查标题顺序与原生表格表头。~Check keyboard behavior, accessible names, markup validity, heading order and table headers.|原生元素也需正确名称与状态；用ARIA改变role并不会自动实现全部键盘行为。~Native elements still need names/states; adding an ARIA role does not implement keyboard behavior.

responsive-css|布局需同时处理可用宽度、内容最小尺寸和间距。Grid适合双向轨道，Flex适合一维排列；项目的默认最小宽度可能使长代码或单词撑出容器。~Layout balances available width, intrinsic sizes and gaps. Grid handles two-dimensional tracks; Flex handles one axis. Intrinsic minimums can make long content overflow.|先算列、间距与内边距；需要收缩的轨道用minmax(0,1fr)，项目按需min-width:0；选择合理换行；在长文本、缩放及不同桌面宽度实测。~Account for columns/gaps/padding, use shrinkable tracks and min-width where appropriate, then test wrapping, long text, zoom and desktop sizes.|容器720，gap24，左列280；右列剩416。^若右列长代码最小宽600且不能收缩，会溢出。^允许轨道收缩并让代码区受控横向滚动，正文仍正常换行。~A720 container with24 gap and280 left leaves416.^An unshrinkable600-wide code block overflows.^Allow track shrinkage and controlled code scrolling while prose wraps.|测量scrollWidth与clientWidth；检查表格、按钮组和英文长词；确认缩放不裁字。~Measure overflow, test tables/buttons/long English words and ensure zoom does not clip text.|不能只按设备名称定断点；不要用隐藏溢出掩盖被截掉的交互。~Choose breakpoints by content, not device labels; hiding overflow can conceal clipped controls.

dom-events|target指事件起点，currentTarget指当前监听器绑定元素。冒泡把事件传向祖先，默认行为如表单提交与传播是两个机制，preventDefault不等于停止冒泡。~target identifies origin and currentTarget the listener element. Propagation and default actions are separate; preventDefault does not stop bubbling.|识别触发元素与监听层；按生命周期绑定和移除；需要阻止默认行为时显式处理；委托监听要验证目标所属范围，不把任意子元素数据当可信业务值。~Identify origin/listener, bind and clean up by lifecycle, handle defaults explicitly and scope delegated targets without trusting arbitrary child data.|按钮内span被点击，监听器在button和父div。^button监听中target是span、currentTarget是button；之后可能冒泡到div。^阻止表单默认提交不自动取消父监听。~A span inside a button is clicked; button and parent listeners exist.^At the button,target isspan andcurrentTarget button; bubbling can continue.^Preventing submission does not cancel the parent listener.|记录监听次数、target/currentTarget与顺序；卸载再挂载后应不重复触发。~Log listener counts/origin/current element/order and verify remounts do not duplicate handling.|异步回调中应先保存所需值；框架事件封装与原生事件细节要按版本核对。~Capture required values before asynchronous use and check framework/native event differences by version.

keyboard|键盘焦点应跟随阅读和任务顺序。模态对话框让背景不可交互，打开、内部循环、关闭和焦点恢复共同组成完整行为，不能只画一个弹层。~Focus follows task/reading order. A modal needs inert background, initial focus, internal navigation, closure and restoration, not only an overlay.|选合适初始焦点；约束模态内Tab/Shift+Tab；支持Escape及可见关闭；关闭后返回触发点或合理替代；保持焦点可见，不用正tabindex强行重排。~Choose initial focus, implement modal Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape and closing, then restore focus logically with visible indication and no positive-tabindex reordering.|用户用按钮打开长说明弹窗。^可将焦点移到可聚焦标题，避免首段被跳过；Tab仍在弹窗内。^关闭后回触发按钮，背景恢复操作。~A button opens a long explanatory dialog.^A focusable heading can preserve reading context; Tab stays inside.^Closing restores the trigger and background interaction.|仅用键盘走完整任务；检查循环、关闭、恢复、背景不可操作和缩放后的焦点可见性。~Complete the task keyboard-only, checking wrap, close/restore, inert background and visible focus under zoom.|非模态面板不应照搬焦点陷阱；辅助技术实测仍需覆盖名称、角色和内容结构。~Non-modal panels should not trap focus; assistive-technology checks also need names, roles and content structure.

form-errors|校验错误要关联具体字段并说明如何修正，同时保留已经输入的内容。错误摘要、字段提示与异步状态各有职责，不能只用红色或一次toast表达失败。~Validation feedback identifies fields and corrections while preserving input. async-ui|请求状态包括未开始、加载、成功空集、成功有数据和失败。fetch遇到HTTP404通常仍返回Response；旧请求完成也不应覆盖最新操作。~Request states include idle/loading/empty/success/error. Fetch normally resolves HTTP404 responses; stale completions must not overwrite the newest action.|记录当前请求身份；检查response.ok再解析；处理空内容与解析失败；取消或忽略旧响应；保留可重试错误与用户输入，防重复提交。~Track request identity, check response.ok before parsing, handle empty/invalid bodies and cancel/ignore stale results while preserving inputs and preventing duplicate submits.|搜索A先发，B后发；B先返回，A后返回。^仅接受当前请求B的结果；A的晚响应忽略。^空列表显示“无匹配”，网络错误显示可重试，而不是同一空状态。~SearchA starts beforeB but returns later.^KeepB and ignore staleA.^Distinguish a valid empty list from a retryable network failure.|控制返回顺序和失败码；验证最新结果、加载释放、重复提交和卸载清理。~Control response ordering/codes and test latest-result behavior, loading cleanup, duplicates and unmounts.|Abort不保证服务端已撤销写入；重试写操作还需要服务端幂等。~Aborting a client request does not prove server-side cancellation; retried writes need server idempotency.

state-ownership|共享可变信息需要单一可信来源，派生值尽量由原始状态计算。保存两个互相同步的副本会制造不可能状态；状态应代表用户选择而非重复缓存可计算结果。~Shared mutable information needs one source of truth. Derive values rather than synchronizing redundant copies that can disagree.|找出需要读写该状态的组件；提升到最近共同祖先；传值与事件；存稳定标识而非重复对象；派生筛选或总量在渲染中计算。~Find readers/writers, lift state to their closest common ancestor, pass values/handlers, store stable IDs and compute derived filters/totals.|列表选中id=7，详情从列表按id取对象。^编辑列表后详情自动读取新对象。^若同时存selectedObject副本，可能仍显示旧名称。~A list stores selectedID7 and derives its detail object.^Editing the list updates detail automatically.^A separate selectedObject copy can retain stale names.|列举用户动作后的允许状态；确认兄弟组件同步且没有互相追赶的effect。~Enumerate allowed post-action states and verify sibling synchronization without competing effects.|提升不是把所有状态放全局；临时输入可留局部，跨页面持久状态需明确账户与恢复边界。~Lifting does not mean globalizing everything; local drafts and persistent account state have different scopes.

repro-build|锁文件固定依赖解析，干净安装减少环境残留。npm ci要求清单与锁文件一致，并且安装配置也会影响依赖树；构建成功还要关联实际产物。~Lockfiles fix resolution and clean installs reduce residue. npm ci requires manifest/lock agreement; install configuration also affects the tree, and builds need artifact provenance.|记录Node/npm与安装参数；提交匹配锁文件；在隔离目录npm ci后构建；保存提交、锁摘要和产物摘要；检查缺失或幽灵依赖。~Record runtime/install flags, maintain matching locks, install/build cleanly and retain commit/lock/artifact digests while checking undeclared dependencies.|package.json新增库而lock未更新。^npm ci应失败，不能在CI里删除锁文件绕过。^在开发流程更新并审核锁文件后再重建。~A package is added without updating the lock.^npm ci should fail, not delete the lock inCI.^Update/review the lock deliberately, then rebuild.|全新环境执行安装和构建；核对输出资源与部署内容；记录平台差异与安装标志。~Test fresh installation/build, reconcile deployed assets and record platform/flag differences.|锁定依赖不保证跨OS逐字节一致或供应链安全；安装生命周期脚本仍可能运行。~A lockfile guarantees neither cross-platform bit identity nor supply-chain safety; lifecycle scripts may still execute.

browser-tests|端到端测试验证用户可见行为，定位契约应比DOM结构稳定。条件等待表达真实成功标准；隔离测试数据防止执行顺序影响结果。~End-to-end tests target visible behavior and stable locator contracts. Condition-based waits express success; isolated data prevents order dependence.|准备独立账号与记录；按role/name定位；完成真实动作并等待可观察结果；对失败保存截图、日志和版本；把外部不稳定依赖纳入受控范围。~Prepare isolated records, use role/name locators, perform real actions and await outcomes, retaining version/screenshots/logs and controlling unstable dependencies.|提交保存后按钮消失，成功消息出现。^点击语义按钮并等待消息，不固定睡眠五秒。^另核对刷新后数据存在，区分瞬时UI反馈与持久化。~A save button is followed by a success message.^Click by semantics and await the message, not a fixed sleep.^Refresh to distinguish transient feedback from persistence.|重排测试顺序和重复运行；验证失败路径和异步返回；检查证据能定位实际步骤。~Repeat/reorder tests, exercise failures/async responses and ensure evidence identifies the failing step.|模拟接口检查不能冒称真实后端集成；截图一致也不能代替业务断言。~Mocked interfaces are not real-backend integration, and matching screenshots do not replace behavioral assertions.

web-vitals|LCP描述主要内容加载，INP关注交互响应，CLS关注布局位移。实验室诊断与真实用户现场分布不同，单次快速运行不代表所有用户体验。~LCP concerns main-content loading, INP responsiveness and CLS layout stability. Laboratory runs differ from real-user distributions; one fast result is not universal experience.|选关键页面与用户群；记录设备、网络、缓存和版本；先用实验工具定位资源/主线程/位移；再按现场分布评估，通常关注桌面与移动分别的75分位。~Define routes/groups and record device/network/cache/version. Diagnose resources/main-thread/shifts in lab, then evaluate field distributions and segmented75th percentiles.|图片未预留尺寸，加载后把按钮推下80px。^先固定图片比例或尺寸，减少位移。^修改后复核CLS与真实操作，不把LCP变快当作位移问题已解决。~An unsized image pushes a button80px after loading.^Reserve its size/aspect ratio.^Recheck CLS and interaction rather than assuming fasterLCP fixes shifting.|重复控制条件测量并保留分布；查看慢交互与位移来源；声明未覆盖的用户环境。~Repeat controlled measurements, inspect slow interactions/shifts and disclose untested environments.|指标阈值与定义会演进；分数只是线索，不能用隐藏内容或禁用功能换取漂亮结果。~Definitions/thresholds evolve; do not improve scores by hiding content or disabling useful behavior.

browser-security|把不可信文本当HTML解析会改变代码执行边界。CSP通过响应策略约束资源与脚本来源，但它是纵深防御，不能代替正确输出处理和授权。~Parsing untrusted text as HTML crosses an execution boundary. release-checks|验收证据必须绑定构建、环境和范围。鼠标正常不代表键盘正常，一条路由正常不代表所有资源或账户隔离正常；未测应保留未知。~Acceptance evidence identifies build/environment/scope. http-semantics|安全方法不请求状态改变，幂等表示重复同类请求的预期效果与一次相同，并非响应必须相同。认证失败、无权限、冲突和输入错误应按契约明确区分。~Safe methods do not request state changes; idempotency concerns intended effects, not identical responses. Distinguish authentication, permission, conflict and input failures.|为操作选择方法和资源；写成功及失败状态；声明重试与缓存行为；让状态、正文和副作用一致，避免把业务失败都包装成200。~Choose methods/resources, define statuses/retry/cache semantics and align response bodies with side effects instead of disguising failures as200.|DELETE同一已授权资源两次，第二次可能404。^预期资源仍不存在，效果幂等。^两次状态不同并不推翻幂等；POST是否可安全重试取决于额外业务契约。~DELETE twice may return404 on the second call.^The resource remains absent, so intended effect is idempotent.^Different statuses do not negate idempotency; POST retries need a business contract.|按同请求重复、身份缺失、权限不足、无效输入和并发冲突检查实际状态及数据。~Check repeated operations, missing credentials, denial, invalid inputs and conflicts against response/data effects.|HTTP语义不自动实现数据库原子性或对象权限；具体披露存在性策略还需安全约定。~HTTP semantics do not implement atomicity or object authorization; existence-disclosure policy needs explicit design.

api-contract|接口契约描述路径、参数、正文、响应与安全要求。结构定义与业务不变量不同：字段是整数不代表值域合法，也不代表该用户可执行动作。~Contracts describe paths, parameters, bodies, responses and security. Shape differs from business invariants and authority.|为每个操作写请求/响应schema、必填与空值规则；说明错误格式和状态；给合法、边界和拒绝示例；用生产者与消费者验证同一契约。~Define schemas/required/null rules, error formats/statuses and valid/boundary/denied examples, checking producer and consumer agreement.|quantity规定integer且minimum=1，收到0或字符串2。^0违反范围，字符串违反类型。^按契约拒绝并指向字段，不能因可转换就静默接受所有输入。~quantity is integer with minimum1; inputs0 and string2 differ.^One violates range, the other type.^Reject per contract rather than silently accepting coercions.|对照schema运行边界样本；检查响应错误字段稳定；比较文档、实现与客户端期望。~Validate boundary examples, stable error fields and agreement among documentation, implementation and client.|OpenAPI版本的Schema能力有差异；声明安全方案不等于服务端已经执行授权。~Schema capabilities vary by OpenAPI version; declaring security does not enforce it.

Layering creates responsibility/test boundaries, not mandatory boilerplate classes.|控制器校验请求形状并映射错误；服务根据领域状态执行规则与事务；持久层暴露必要读写；避免在控制器重复折扣或付款逻辑。~Validate/map requests at controllers, apply domain rules/transactions in services and expose scoped persistence operations without duplicating business logic.|HTTP下单与批处理都需要折扣规则。^两者调用同一服务方法；控制器不直接计算两套价格。^修改折扣后只更新规则，并用两种入口集成复核。~HTTP orders and batch jobs share discount rules.^Both call one service rather than independent controller calculations.^Update the rule and verify both integrations.|用纯规则单测和真实存储集成分别验证；模拟存储失败时检查事务与错误映射。~Separate rule unit tests from real-storage integration and test transaction/error mapping on storage failure.|Spring参数校验与方法校验异常可能不同，按版本与签名处理；加注解不保证业务权限正确。~Spring parameter/method validation can raise different exceptions; handle version/signature specifics and enforce permissions separately.

state-rules|业务状态限制哪些事件可以改变对象。幂等键标识同一次业务意图，必须与请求内容绑定；重复键配不同参数不能当成同一合法操作。~State rules constrain transitions. Idempotency keys identify one business intent and must be bound to request content; changed parameters are not the same operation.|画状态/事件/条件表；用版本或条件更新处理竞争；在事务中保存操作结果和幂等回执；重复同内容返回已有结果，不同内容报冲突。~Specify transitions, use versioned/conditional writes for races and persist results/receipts transactionally. Replay matching requests, conflict on changed intent.|同键K请求订单A扣款30，网络断开后重试。^若已提交，返回原回执，不新增扣款。^同键K改成50应拒绝，而非覆盖原结果。~KeyK charges orderA30 and the connection drops.^Return the committed receipt on retry without charging again.^ReusingK for50 must conflict, not overwrite.|同时测试首次、重复、参数变化、并发和事务中断；核对逻辑操作只发生一次。~Test first/replay/changed/concurrent/interrupted requests and reconcile one logical side effect.|“先查有没有，再写”若不原子仍会竞争；幂等记录保留期和跨服务边界需另定。~Non-atomic check-then-write races; receipt retention and cross-service idempotency need explicit policies.

schema-constraints|主键标识实体行，外键维护引用，唯一约束限制重复，CHECK表达行级条件。NULL语义与约束组合要明确；应用提示无法约束所有写入路径。~Primary/foreign/unique/check constraints protect different invariants. integration-tests|集成检查跨越真实组件边界，如服务、数据库和权限。契约测试检查消息结构与约定，但不自动覆盖真实存储约束、事务或部署连通性。~Integration tests cross real component boundaries; contract checks verify message agreements but not automatically real constraints, transactions or deployment connectivity.|选择风险边界；用隔离数据库和账号准备夹具；覆盖正常、拒绝、冲突与存储失败；执行真实读写后核对状态并清理自建材料。~Choose risk boundaries, prepare isolated database/accounts and exercise success/denial/conflict/failure, verifying real state and cleaning owned fixtures.|服务创建重复邮箱，真实库有UNIQUE。^集成测试应触发约束并验证映射成约定冲突响应。^只模拟仓库返回值的单测不能证明约束实际生效。~A duplicate email meets a realUNIQUE constraint.^Integration must verify rejection and the agreed conflict mapping.^Mocked repository output cannot establish actual enforcement.|检查测试是否真的经过目标边界；重复与乱序运行仍稳定；保存版本、夹具及未覆盖依赖。~Confirm the intended boundary is real, rerun independently and record version/fixtures/excluded dependencies.|把全部外部接口模拟后不能称完整端到端；不要在生产库运行破坏性夹具。~Fully mocked externals are not complete end-to-end integration; do not run destructive fixtures on production data.

timeouts-retry|超时表示调用者未及时得到结果，不证明服务端没有执行。重试可能放大负载或重复写入，必须有总预算、次数上限及幂等契约。~Timeout means the caller lacks a timely result, not that execution did not occur.
