Trace dependencies and use metrics for scope, with access/retention policies.|请求R12失败，服务A和B日志共享traceT8。^沿T8定位B的存储超时；日志保留错误类别，不存完整Authorization头。^再检查同版本错误率决定是否为系统问题。~RequestR12 fails across services sharingtraceT8.^Trace a storage timeout without logging the fullAuthorization header.^Check version-level error rate to assess scope.|测试关联传播、字段类型、时区和脱敏；核对采样与丢失日志对结论的影响。~Check propagation, field types, zones and redaction, documenting sampling/missing-log limitations.|高基数字段不宜随意作指标标签；日志完善也不代表已证明根因。~Avoid uncontrolled high-cardinality metric labels; detailed logs alone do not establish root cause.

dataset-grain|粒度定义一行代表哪个业务事件，键验证这个约定。事实中的数量可加性取决于维度与时间；快照余额不能简单跨日期相加当收入。~Grain defines the business event per row and keys enforce it. Measure additivity depends on dimensions/time; balances across dates are not revenue.|写粒度声明；选稳定业务键或复合键；列出度量的可加维度；把不同粒度事实分开建模；用重复键和重复计量样本核对。~Declare grain, choose stable/composite keys, state additivity, separate mixed-grain facts and test duplicate keys/measures.|订单A两明细金额10、15，订单级运费5。^明细总额25；若两行都放运费再SUM，会把运费算10。^运费应按订单粒度汇总或按明确分摊规则处理。~OrderA has lines10/15 and shipping5.^Lines total25, but copying shipping onto both yields10.^Aggregate shipping at order grain or apply an explicit allocation rule.|检查一键一行约束，分别对账明细和订单总量；对时间快照验证不可加维度。~Check key uniqueness and reconcile line/order totals separately, including non-additive snapshot dimensions.|技术代理键不自动解决业务重复；粒度变更需要处理历史和下游语义。~Surrogate keys do not resolve business duplicates; grain changes affect history/downstream semantics.

transform-sql|转换由筛选、关联、派生和聚合组成，每一步都可能改变实体覆盖和总量。把逻辑拆成可检查的中间表比一条复杂查询更容易定位错误。~Filtering, joining, derivation and aggregation each change coverage/totals. Inspectable intermediate stages improve diagnosis over one opaque query.|逐步写CTE或暂存层；记录每步行数、不同键数、金额与排除原因；连接前确认基数；输出与输入按同窗口对账。~Use staged CTEs/models, tracking rows/distinct keys/totals/exclusions. Validate cardinality before joining and reconcile identical windows.|输入金额300，过滤无效单20，期望输出280；关联后却变330。^先核对过滤阶段280，再查关联重复贡献50的键。^避免直接从最终差额猜过滤规则错误。~Input300 minus invalid20 should yield280, but joined output330.^Confirm280 at the filter stage, then trace duplicated keys adding50.^Do not infer the wrong stage from the final discrepancy alone.|保存各阶段统计和失败键；修复后验证结果等价及重复运行稳定。~Retain stage summaries/failing keys and verify corrected output plus repeatability.|NULL、时区与货币精度会改变口径；示例SQL需按目标引擎验证类型及函数差异。~Nulls, time zones and money precision affect definitions; validate engine-specific types/functions.

partition-evolution|分区组织物理数据以便裁剪扫描，不等于业务主键。模式演进影响字段含义与读写兼容；某些表格式允许新旧分区布局共存，并不会立即重写旧文件。~Partitions organize physical data for pruning, not entity identity. Schema evolution affects semantics/compatibility; some table formats retain multiple partition layouts without rewriting old files.|从查询过滤与写入分布选分区；记录字段类型/标识和缺失语义；评审新旧读写器；在隔离表上测试旧文件、新写入和回读，再计划重写。~Choose partitions by query/write patterns, define field/missing semantics and test old/new readers/files/writes in isolation before planning rewrites.|旧数据按月分区，新数据改按日。^在支持演进的Iceberg中，旧文件仍用旧spec，新文件用新spec。^读计划需同时识别两者，改配置不等于旧文件已重排。~Old data is monthly, new data daily.^Iceberg can retain old specs/files while new writes use the new spec.^Readers plan both; a metadata change is not a physical rewrite.|检查分区裁剪、历史回读、NULL字段和新旧写入器；比较同条件结果及扫描量。~Check pruning, historical reads, null fields and reader/writer compatibility, comparing results/scans.|这是Iceberg演进语义，不适用于所有Hive/数据库表；具体引擎版本和连接器支持需单独核对。~These are Iceberg semantics, not universal Hive/database behavior; check engine/connector versions.

dag-intervals|任务运行时间与处理的数据窗口不同。逻辑窗口由调度表定义；Airflow不同timetable可能产生连续区间或零宽触发点，不能只见@daily就推断昨天全天。~Execution time differs from data interval. Timetables define intervals; Airflow variants can use continuous intervals or zero-width triggers, so @daily alone is insufficient.|明确timetable和时区；将输入窗口作为参数；规定上游就绪条件和依赖；迟跑或重跑仍使用目标窗口；记录实际开始结束与逻辑范围。~Declare timetable/timezone, parameterize input intervals, define readiness/dependencies and keep logical scope stable for delayed runs/reruns.|指定窗口[11月3日00:00,11月4日00:00)，实际11月5日执行。^查询仍限定该半开区间，而非NOW减一天。^手动触发时显式确认窗口，不从执行日期猜测。~An explicitNov3–Nov4 half-open interval runs onNov5.^Query that interval, not NOW minus one day.^Confirm manual-trigger intervals rather than guessing from execution date.|用正常、迟跑、补跑和时区切换验证输入范围；核对依赖产物窗口一致。~Test scheduled/delayed/manual/backfill and timezone cases, reconciling dependency intervals.|Airflow3默认cron触发规则与旧习惯可能不同；课程不把logical_date自动当成完整日窗口。~Airflow3 cron defaults can differ from older habits; logical_date is not automatically a whole-day interval.

idempotent-batch|批处理幂等要求同一逻辑输入重跑后输出等价，而不是只保证作业返回成功。固定窗口替换、稳定键合并和原子提交可以避免重复追加。~Batch idempotency means equivalent output after rerunning the same logical input, not only successful job status. Stable scopes/keys and atomic writes prevent duplication.|固定输入版本与目标窗口；选择替换或按键合并；先写暂存并验证，再原子提交；处理部分失败和并发重跑；保留运行与输出摘要。~Fix input/version/window, choose replacement/upsert, validate staged output and commit atomically, covering partial/concurrent reruns with provenance.|日分区有40行，同输入重跑仍应40行且金额相同。^直接append第二次变80行。^替换固定分区或按稳定键合并，并在失败时保持旧完整版本。~A daily partition has40 rows and should remain40 with equal totals.^Appending produces80.^Replace/upsert stable scope and preserve the prior complete version on failure.|连跑两次比较键集合、行数、金额与摘要；注入写入一半失败再恢复。~Compare keys/counts/totals/digests across repeats and inject partial-write recovery.|去重窗口过短或输入版本变更会改变语义；幂等写入不能代替来源完整性验证。~Short dedup windows/input changes alter semantics; idempotency does not establish input completeness.

backfills|补数围绕缺失逻辑窗口及其下游依赖，而非只按执行日期重跑。补上上游后，依赖旧结果的下游可能也要重算；并发和发布范围需要控制。~Backfills target missing intervals and downstream dependencies. Correcting upstream may require recomputing dependent outputs; control concurrency and publication scope.|列缺口与来源版本；沿依赖确定重算范围；限定并发和资源；分窗口执行、对账和发布；记录失败、重试与受影响报告。~Inventory gaps/versions, trace recomputation scope, limit concurrency/resources and execute/reconcile/publish per interval with failure/report provenance.|周一缺数据，周二累计指标依赖周一。^只补周一明细还不够，需要重算周二累计及相关输出。^每个窗口对账后再通知下游更新。~Monday data is missing and Tuesday cumulative output depends on it.^Backfilling Monday details alone is insufficient.^Recompute dependent totals and reconcile before notifying downstreams.|比较缺口清单与成功窗口；核对下游总量及版本；确认正常日调度未被补数资源饿死。~Reconcile gap/success lists and downstream versions/totals while protecting normal scheduling resources.|重放可能调用外部副作用；需要确认幂等与授权，不应把所有历史无限并发重跑。~Replays can cause external side effects; verify idempotency/authority and avoid unlimited historical concurrency.

event-time|事件时间描述发生时刻，处理时间描述系统看到它的时刻。水位线表达系统对事件时间进度的判断，不是保证所有更早事件都永不再来。~Event time describes occurrence and processing time arrival/handling. Watermarks express progress assumptions, not an absolute promise that older events cannot arrive.|定义窗口归属与时区；选择时间戳与水位线策略；规定迟到、空闲分区和修正输出；区分首次结果与最终策略，并测试乱序输入。~Define window/timezone, timestamp/watermark strategy and late/idle-partition/correction behavior, distinguishing initial results from finalization policy.|事件10:01在10:08到达，水位线已到10:05。^按事件时间它属于较早窗口，是迟到事件。^是否丢弃、侧输出或更新由允许迟到策略决定，不能直接改成10:08发生。~An event at10:01 arrives10:08 after watermark10:05.^It is late for its event-time window.^Drop/side-output/update follows policy; do not rewrite occurrence time to arrival time.|乱序、迟到、时钟偏差和空闲分区都要演练；核对窗口计数和修正版本。~Exercise disorder/lateness/skew/idle inputs and reconcile window counts/correction versions.|Flink水位线合并与窗口触发细节依算子/配置；本课时间线不冒称完整运行时证明。~Flink watermark/trigger details depend on operators/configuration; a desk timeline is not a runtime proof.

dedup-replay|稳定事件ID表示同一业务事件；去重状态的保留期限定能识别多久以前的重复。消费位置恢复与目标写入必须一起考虑，否则重放会重复落地。~Stable event IDs identify business events and state retention bounds deduplication. Consumer progress and sink writes must be coordinated to avoid replay duplicates.|定义ID生成与唯一范围；选状态保留和迟到策略；设计目标幂等写入；在提交前后分别中断并重放，核对事件与输出。~Define ID scope, retention/lateness and idempotent sinks, then interrupt before/after commits and reconcile replay outputs.|输入e1=10、e2=20、e1=10，均在窗口内。^按ID只保留e1、e2，总额30。^同ID不同金额则是冲突，不能静默按“重复”丢弃证据。~Events e1=10,e2=20,e1=10 fall in one window.^Deduplicate to total30.^The sameID with a changed amount is a conflict, not a safely disposable duplicate.|比较唯一ID、冲突ID、输出行和总量；测试超过去重保留期的重放。~Reconcile unique/conflicting IDs, rows/totals and replay beyond retention.|只说exactly-once标签不够，需确认来源、状态与接收端实际保证；跨系统失败仍需验证。~An exactly-once label is insufficient without source/state/sink guarantees and cross-system failure tests.

incremental-validation|增量结果应与同输入版本、同窗口和同规则的全量结果比较。迟到和更正会改变旧窗口，修正范围与下游通知需要可追溯。~Compare incremental and full results under identical inputs, windows and rules. Late/corrected data changes historical windows and needs traceable propagation.|固定对账窗口与版本；比较键集合、计数和金额；定位新增、删除及变更键；按可修正窗口重算并发布新版本，记录依赖更新。~Fix window/version, compare keys/counts/totals, identify added/deleted/changed keys and recompute/version allowed windows with downstream updates.|全量键A10、B20、C30；增量只有A10、B20。^差额30来自C缺失。^查C的到达与处理状态，比只比较总差额更能定位漏算。~Full data hasA10,B20,C30; incremental hasA10,B20.^MissingC explains30.^Inspect its arrival/processing state rather than only the aggregate gap.|双向检查缺键与多键，比较同键值；修正后再次对账并保存旧新版本。~Check missing/extra keys both ways and same-key values, then reconcile corrections with version history.|总额相同也可能一正一负抵消错误；超过修正窗口的数据要有明确异常处置。~Equal totals can hide offsetting errors; out-of-window corrections need explicit handling.

pipeline-tests|数据测试把预期转为可重复断言：唯一、非空、引用与业务规则分别检查不同问题。失败行是调查入口，严重度与发布门槛需要与用途绑定。~Data assertions cover uniqueness, nulls, relationships and business rules separately. Failing rows support diagnosis; severity/release gates follow intended use.|按模型粒度选约束；写适用分母和失败样本；在构建前后合适阶段执行；保存失败行与责任人；修复后重跑相关及下游检查。~Choose grain-aware assertions, define applicability/failures, run at appropriate stages and retain failing rows/owners before retesting dependencies.|订单A、B、B、NULL。^唯一性发现重复B；非空发现NULL。^只跑unique可能不能替代not_null，两项都需要。~KeysA,B,B,NULL.^Uniqueness findsB; not-null findsNULL.^One test does not replace the other.|注入已知失败确认测试会红；恢复干净数据确认会绿；检查告警/拦截策略实际生效。~Seed known failures/pass controls and verify warning/blocking behavior actually applies.|dbt data_tests参数结构依版本变化；课堂断言通过不证明所有数据内容真实。~dbt data_tests argument syntax varies by version; passing assertions does not establish factual truth.

lineage|血缘把作业定义、一次运行及输入输出数据集关联。作业名不等于运行实例；窗口、版本和数据集命名空间决定影响分析精度。~Lineage links job definitions, run instances and input/output datasets. Jobs differ from runs; namespaces, versions and intervals determine impact precision.|给数据集稳定命名空间和名称；为每次运行记录runId、状态、窗口和版本；连输入输出边；发生问题时沿边查受影响的下游运行与发布。~Name datasets stably, record run IDs/states/intervals/versions and input-output edges, then trace affected downstream runs/releases.|Raw订单→Clean订单→日报；11月6日Clean运行失败。^定位读取该窗口的日报运行，而不是把所有历史日报都标错。^保留具体runId和输入版本作为依据。~Raw→Clean→Daily; theNov6 Clean run fails.^Find Daily runs consuming that interval instead of marking every historical report invalid.^Retain run IDs/input versions.|从一个输出反查输入与运行，再从输入正查输出；比较图与实际查询/调度依赖。~Trace backward and forward and compare graph edges with actual query/scheduling dependencies.|未采集的边会形成盲区；血缘图完整度与数据正确性是不同指标。~Uncollected edges create blind spots; lineage completeness differs from data correctness.

freshness-recovery|任务成功、数据到达和数据可用是不同状态。新鲜度以业务期待的截止时间与实际可用时间衡量，还要考虑完整性和下游发布。~Task success, arrival and usable data differ. Freshness compares expected and actual availability while accounting for completeness/downstream publication.|定义到达与可用门槛；记录预期窗口、截止和来源；超时先定位来源/转换/发布；恢复后对账并通知受影响使用方，保留补数责任。~Define arrival/availability criteria and deadlines, locate delays across source/transform/publication and reconcile/notify after recovery.|08:00截止，07:55作业成功但只有一半来源；08:40数据齐全并验收。^可用时间为08:40，延迟40分钟。^不能用作业07:55成功宣称按时交付。~Deadline08:00, job success07:55 with half the sources, usable complete data08:40.^Availability delay is40 minutes.^Job success does not establish on-time delivery.|核对来源完整性、规则通过和下游实际可读；比较恢复前后窗口与总量。~Verify source completeness, assertions and downstream readability, reconciling intervals/totals.|未知期待时间不能填零延迟；新鲜但错误的数据仍不可用。~Unknown deadlines do not imply zero delay; fresh but incorrect data may remain unusable.

acceptance|验收条件把需求转成可观察的前置、动作和结果。可追踪性要知道需求由哪些用例覆盖，也要能从失败回到受影响需求，不能只数用例数量。~Acceptance criteria make requirements observable through preconditions/actions/outcomes. Traceability links both coverage and failures back to requirements, beyond case counts.|澄清模糊词与异常路径；为每条要求写可验证结果；建立需求-用例对应；检查未覆盖和无需求依据的用例；与业务角色核对预期。~Clarify ambiguity/exceptions, define observable outcomes, map requirements/cases and inspect gaps/orphan cases with business reviewers.|要求余额不足不能转账。^前置余额20、请求30；预期拒绝、余额仍20、收款方不变。^只检查出现红字不足以覆盖数据副作用。~Balance20, requested transfer30.^Expect denial with both balances unchanged.^A red error alone does not verify side effects.|双向追踪需求与用例，核对每个预期可观察且不依赖实现细节。~Trace both directions and ensure each expectation is observable without unnecessary implementation coupling.|验收条件不是设计实现步骤；不明确的业务规则应列待确认而非测试者猜测。~Criteria are not implementation recipes; ambiguous rules need clarification, not invented expectations.

risk-priority|产品风险由可能性与影响共同评估，优先级用于有限资源分配。数值模型是组织约定的排序工具，不是精确概率或损失预测。~Risk combines likelihood/impact to allocate limited effort. Numeric models rank under agreed assumptions, not precise probabilities/losses.|识别关键业务和故障后果；按同一尺度评估并记理由；先覆盖高影响风险；随新证据调整，并记录暂缓范围和残余风险。~Identify critical outcomes/consequences, assess on consistent scales with rationale, prioritize high impact and revise with evidence, retaining deferred/residual scope.|A可能性3影响5，B可能性4影响2。^简化乘积A15、B8，优先A但仍核对严重性门槛。^若安全风险不能接受，不能被低估计可能性稀释。~A scores3×5=15,B4×2=8.^PrioritizeA under this model while respecting severe-risk gates.^Unacceptable safety/security risk cannot be averaged away.|比较评分依据与实际故障证据；审查排名对尺度变化是否敏感。~Review evidence behind ratings and sensitivity to scale changes.|主观等级相乘不产生统计概率；风险优先不代表低优先功能永远无需测试。~Ordinal multiplication is not statistical probability; lower priority does not mean never tested.

test-levels|单元、集成、系统与验收测试关注不同对象和风险。在哪一层发现缺陷与缺陷属于哪一层不是同一问题；选最能稳定暴露风险的最低必要边界。~Unit/integration/system/acceptance tests address different objects/risks. Detection location differs from defect origin; choose the smallest meaningful boundary.|为风险选择对象和真实/模拟依赖；单元验证局部规则，集成验证接口与存储，系统走完整流程，验收核对业务用途；明确重叠与缺口。~Select objects and real/mocked dependencies; distinguish local rules, boundaries, whole workflows and business acceptance, documenting overlap/gaps.|金额舍入函数错适合单元；数据库唯一约束映射适合集成；下单到付款适合系统。^分别准备具体预期。^不能因系统一条成功流程就取消局部边界与拒绝路径。~Rounding fits unit tests, uniqueness mapping integration, order-to-payment system tests.^Give each concrete expectations.^One happy system path cannot replace boundary/denial coverage.|检查每层真正经过的边界和替身；把失败可定位性与运行成本纳入选择。~Inspect real boundaries/test doubles and balance diagnostic value against cost.|金字塔是思考工具，不是固定比例指标；用户验收不能由开发者自测标签替代。~Test pyramids are heuristics, not mandatory ratios; developer checks are not user acceptance.

boundary|等价类按预期行为划分，边界值适用于有序类。边界附近容易发生包含/排除和偏移错误；正常值、类型和缺失仍需单独覆盖。~Equivalence classes group expected behavior; boundary analysis applies to ordered classes. Inclusion/off-by-one errors cluster near edges, but normal/type/missing inputs still matter.|确定有效/无效类与端点是否包含；选边界及邻点；区分二值和三值策略；写输入-预期表，再补普通、类型和空值案例。~Define classes/inclusion, choose boundary neighbors and a two-/three-value strategy, then add ordinary/type/null cases with expected outcomes.|整数数量2至8（含）。^二值重点1、2、8、9；更严格三值可补3、7。^普通5应通过，2.5是否允许需类型契约决定。~Integers2–8 inclusive.^Two-value checks1,2,8,9; three-value adds3,7.^Ordinary5 passes;2.5 follows the type contract.|核对每个类与端点有覆盖；故意把<=改成<，确认用例能检出。~Check class/edge coverage and verify cases detect an intentional <= to < defect.|连续数值“最近邻”依精度约定；无序枚举不应硬套数值边界。~Nearest neighbors depend on numeric precision; unordered enums do not have numeric boundaries.

decision-tables|决策表将条件组合映射到动作，帮助发现遗漏与矛盾。不可达组合、无关条件和业务约束应显式区分，不能随意删列减少测试。~Decision tables map condition combinations to actions, exposing omissions/contradictions. Distinguish impossible combinations and irrelevant conditions under explicit rules.|列条件及取值；枚举可行组合；写每列动作；合并动作相同且无关的条件；为保留规则选用例并追踪需求。~List values, enumerate feasible combinations, define actions and merge only justified don't-care conditions, tracing cases to rules.|条件会员与满额，会员或满额任一满足即免运。^00收费，01/10/11免运。^若错误实现为同时满足，01或10能发现缺陷。~Member/free-threshold rule grants shipping if either is true.^00 charges;01/10/11 waive.^Cases01/10 detect an incorrect AND implementation.|检查规则互斥或优先顺序；每个可行列都有预期，未知条件先澄清。~Check rule precedence/exclusivity and expectations for each feasible column; clarify unknowns.|组合数可能爆炸，可按风险选择技术；压缩表格不能丢失真实业务差异。~Combinations can grow rapidly; risk-based reduction must preserve meaningful distinctions.

state-transition|状态模型由当前状态、事件、守卫条件、动作和下一状态组成。非法事件应有拒绝或无效响应；只测合法最终状态会漏掉中途错误转换。~Models combine state/event/guard/action/next state. Illegal events need rejection or no-op behavior; checking only final success misses invalid transitions.|画状态表及初始终止态；列合法和非法事件；设计路径覆盖转换与守卫；执行后同时核对状态和副作用。~Define initial/terminal states and legal/illegal events, design transition/guard paths and verify state plus side effects.|订单待支付→已支付→已关闭；关闭后再支付禁止。^在已关闭发送支付事件应拒绝并保持关闭。^不能因付款接口返回成功就忽略重复扣款。~Pending→Paid→Closed; payingClosed is forbidden.^Reject and preserveClosed.^A success response cannot excuse duplicate charging.|覆盖每条转换、守卫失败与重复事件；检查非法动作没有写入。~Cover transitions, failed guards and duplicate events, verifying no illegal mutations.|模型完整度依需求；并发与时间事件还需额外分析，单路径不能证明全部状态行为。~Concurrency/time events need extra analysis; one path does not establish full model correctness.

exploratory|探索式测试把学习、设计和执行结合，但仍需要主题、范围与记录。发现线索不等于确认缺陷，未探索范围应留下而非用“随便点过”代替。~Exploration combines learning/design/execution under a charter, scope and records. Leads differ from confirmed defects and untested scope stays explicit.|设定风险主题和时间盒；准备素材；边执行边记录假设、操作和观察；对异常做最小复现；结束整理覆盖、线索与后续。~Define a risk charter/timebox/materials, record hypotheses/actions/observations, reproduce anomalies and summarize coverage/leads/follow-up.|主题折扣叠加，尝试先券后会员与反序。^发现两顺序总价不同，保留输入、顺序和截图。^规则未确认前标为待核对差异，不直接判错。~Explore coupon/member order.^Different totals require saved inputs/order/screenshots.^Mark an unresolved rule discrepancy before declaring a defect.|核对记录能复做，区分事实和推断；说明主题外发现及未覆盖区域。~Check reproducibility, separate fact/inference and record out-of-charter findings and gaps.|探索不是无目标点击；时间盒到期不证明功能正确，也不能替代关键规则的重复检查。~Exploration is not random clicking; timebox completion does not establish correctness or replace repeatable critical checks.

defect-reproduction|缺陷报告要把期望和实际差异转为可重现条件。严重度描述影响，优先级描述安排；二者相关但不应混为一个字段。~Defect reports specify reproducible expected/actual differences. Severity describes impact; priority schedules response and is a separate decision.|写版本、环境、前置和最小步骤；附输入与证据；明确预期依据；估计影响及绕过；修复后复测并保持报告历史。~Record version/environment/preconditions/minimal steps, inputs/evidence and expected basis, then impact/workaround and confirmation history.|同一订单重复点保存产生两条记录。^记录账号范围、按钮操作、网络和重复键，而不只写“保存坏了”。^影响可能严重，处理顺序还取决于频率与发布计划。~Repeated save creates two records.^Capture scoped account/actions/network/keys rather than 'save broken'.^Severity and scheduling depend on distinct impact/frequency/release considerations.|让未参与者按报告重现；检查环境差异、必要条件和敏感信息已处理。~Have another tester reproduce it, checking environment/required conditions and redaction.|偶现缺陷也可提交，但要给频率与已知条件；不可编造必现或根因。~Intermittent defects are reportable with frequency/conditions, not invented certainty or causation.

retest-regression|确认测试验证原缺陷是否修复，回归检查变更是否破坏其他行为。两者的输入依据与范围不同，“原例绿了”不能推定周边都正常。~Confirmation verifies the original fix; regression checks unintended effects elsewhere. Passing the original case does not cover surrounding behavior.|先复做原复现与变体；根据改动影响选相邻规则、接口和共享组件；记录未跑项；对新失败区分原缺陷残留与引入问题。~Replay the original/variants, select adjacent rules/interfaces/shared components by impact and distinguish residual from introduced failures, retaining untested scope.|修复百分比舍入后原退款案例通过。^回归折扣、税额、零分母和导出格式。^只修一处函数也可能影响多个金额路径。~A percentage-rounding fix passes the refund case.^Regress discounts/tax/zero denominators/exports.^A shared function affects more than its original case.|将修复提交与复测版本一致；对照影响清单及实际执行证据。~Align fix/test versions and reconcile impact lists with actual execution evidence.|回归范围按风险决定，不要求每次无差别全跑；未跑不能写成通过。~Choose regression by risk rather than always running everything; unrun checks are not passes.

test-data|可重复测试需要独立、可重置的数据与明确前置。参数化复用同一规则的不同输入，不应让测试依赖上一条留下的状态或真实用户秘密。~Repeatable tests need isolated/resettable data. Parameterization varies inputs for one rule without depending on prior tests or real-user secrets.|用合成数据与独立ID；夹具显式准备和回收；参数覆盖有效、边界、错误；控制时钟/随机输入；验证串行、并行和乱序运行。~Use synthetic IDs/fixtures, explicit setup/cleanup, valid/boundary/error parameters and controlled time/randomness; test serial/parallel/reordered execution.|A创建订单，B只在A运行后能读到订单。^给B自己的准备步骤和订单ID。^两测试单独、倒序和并行都应稳定。~TestB reads an order created only byA.^GiveB independent setup/ID.^Both should pass alone, reordered and parallel.|检查测试间共享文件、端口、数据库和时区；清理只覆盖自建资源。~Inspect shared files/ports/databases/zones and clean only owned resources.|过度模拟可能丢失真实约束；固定数据也需覆盖更新后的业务规则。~Excessive mocking can hide real constraints; fixed fixtures still need evolving rule coverage.

stable-assertions|稳定自动化围绕用户可见语义和明确状态，而不是脆弱层级选择器。等待具体条件避免固定延迟；断言需要失败时指出哪个结果不符。~Stable automation uses visible semantics and explicit state rather than fragile selectors. Condition waits avoid fixed delays and assertions should diagnose mismatches.|优先role/name或明确测试契约；缩小定位范围避免歧义；操作后等待真实结果；断言关键值及持久状态，失败保存上下文。~Prefer role/name or explicit test contracts, scope ambiguous targets, await outcomes and assert values/persistence with diagnostic context.|页面两个“保存”，分别属于头像和练习。^先定位练习区域，再选保存按钮。^点击后等“练习已保存”，而不是取全页第一个按钮或睡三秒。~Avatar and practice both haveSave buttons.^Scope to practice, then locateSave.^Await its saved state rather than the first global button or a sleep.|改无关DOM包装后测试仍应通过；故意让业务结果错时测试必须失败。~Tests should survive harmless DOM wrapping but fail on incorrect business results.|选择器稳定不代表断言充分；自动等待无法修复错误的成功条件。~Stable locators do not guarantee useful assertions; auto-waiting cannot fix the wrong success condition.

ci-evidence|持续集成证据要标明提交、依赖、环境和测试范围。失败可能是产品缺陷、环境问题或不稳定测试，反复重跑绿一次不能替代调查。~CI evidence identifies commit/dependencies/environment/scope. Product, environment and flaky-test failures differ; one green retry is not an investigation.|固定运行环境与锁文件；分层执行关键检查；保留日志、报告和产物；对失败分类与复现；阻断规则要与风险对应，显式记录跳过范围。~Fix environment/locks, run layered checks, retain logs/reports/artifacts, reproduce/classify failures and align gates with risk and disclosed skips.|新提交CI失败，本机旧提交通过。^先核对提交与环境，重现同一失败。^不能拿旧本地结果覆盖新提交状态。~CI fails on a new commit while an old local commit passes.^Align version/environment and reproduce.^Old evidence cannot verify the new commit.|从报告定位具体输入、断言、版本和截图；检查日志保留及秘密脱敏。~Trace reports to inputs/assertions/version/screenshots and verify retention/redaction.|通过流水线只覆盖所跑检查；缓存和外部依赖仍可能造成环境差异。~A green pipeline covers only executed checks; caches/external dependencies can still change behavior.

problem-model|问题模型把业务语言转为输入、输出、约束与未知。算法选择之前需知道空输入、重复、单位和规模如何处理；未明确条件不能悄悄补成要求。~Model inputs, outputs, constraints and unknowns before choosing algorithms, including empties, duplicates, units and scale. Assumptions are not requirements.|写输入输出样例；列前置与边界；把模糊条件登记待确认；将任务拆为可检验子问题，再选择实现。~Write input/output examples, prerequisites/bounds and open questions, then divide into testable subproblems before implementation.|任务“计算平均分”，输入可含缺考。^先问缺考是排除、零分还是未知，及空列表返回什么。^规则确定后才能写分母和错误行为。~A mean-score task includes absences.^Clarify excluded/zero/unknown status and empty-list behavior.^Only then define denominator and errors.|让另一人仅用模型复算样例；检查每个假设是否确认，是否存在无定义输入。~Have another person derive examples from the model and inspect unconfirmed assumptions/undefined inputs.|模型不是现实全部细节，需说明忽略项；示例正确不证明所有边界已定义。~Models omit details deliberately; correct examples do not establish complete boundaries.

acceptance-slices|交付切片应贯穿一个最小用户结果，而不是只完成数据库、接口或UI某一技术层。每片都需输入、可观察结果与验证，方便获得早期反馈。~A delivery slice reaches a minimal user outcome, not only a database/API/UI layer. Each needs inputs, observable results and validation for early feedback.|先列用户任务；切出最小可用正常路径；补该片必须的拒绝条件；定义演示与验收；把可推迟功能明确排除而非隐含缺失。~Identify tasks, slice a minimal normal path plus necessary denials, define demonstrations/acceptance and explicitly exclude deferrable scope.|“保存并回看笔记”第一片包含输入、保存、刷新回看。^数据库建表只是内部步骤。^若刷新丢失笔记，这个用户切片仍未完成。~Save-and-revisit notes includes input, persistence and refresh recovery.^A table is an implementation step.^Losing notes on refresh means the slice is incomplete.|从用户入口走到可观察结果；核对保存、错误和最小权限，不只看技术任务勾选。~Walk entry-to-outcome and verify persistence, errors and minimum permissions beyond task checkmarks.|切片小不等于跳过安全或数据完整性；跨团队依赖要显式安排。~Small slices do not omit essential safety/data integrity; expose cross-team dependencies.

design-boundaries|模块边界按共同变化的职责组织，对外提供稳定契约，隐藏易变细节。接口越泄露内部存储与实现，调用者就越容易被局部变化牵连。~Group responsibilities by change patterns, expose stable contracts and hide volatile details. Leaking storage internals couples callers to local changes.|列模块职责与变化原因；定义输入输出、错误和依赖；将外部服务/存储适配放边界；用契约测试验证替换实现不破坏调用者。~Identify responsibilities/change reasons, define inputs/outputs/errors/dependencies and isolate external adapters, validating replacements through contracts.|价格服务只需输入商品与优惠，输出金额和规则版本。^调用者不应依赖内部折扣表列顺序。^更换存储后契约不变，两种实现应给同样结果。~Pricing takes product/offer and returns amount/rule version.^Callers should not depend on discount-table column order.^Storage replacement preserves outcomes/contracts.|按真实用例检查接口是否足够且不过度暴露；替换一个实现做对照。~Check that contracts support real cases without leaking detail and compare interchangeable implementations.|拆得越多不一定越好；跨模块事务和错误传播成本也要纳入设计。~More modules are not automatically better; account for cross-boundary transactions and error propagation.

control-flow|控制流决定哪些路径执行和何时返回。函数应有明确职责、输入约定和返回结果；提前返回可以简化守卫，但不能跳过必要清理或状态一致性。~Control flow selects paths and returns. Functions need clear responsibilities/contracts; guards simplify paths but must preserve cleanup/state consistency.|先列正常、边界和错误输入；写守卫与主路径；用小样例逐行跟踪变量和返回；把重复职责抽成函数，明确异常与资源清理。~List normal/boundary/error inputs, write guards/main path and trace variables/returns before extracting repeated responsibilities and cleanup.|函数负数拒绝，否则求两倍。输入-1、0、4。^分别走错误、边界正常、普通正常路径。^预期拒绝、0、8，不能因if x漏掉0的合法含义。~Reject negatives, otherwise double; inputs-1,0,4.^They exercise error, valid boundary and normal paths.^Expect rejection,0,8; truthiness must not discard valid zero.|为每个条件两侧和返回点建立样例；核对循环终止与资源清理。~Test both sides of conditions, return paths, termination and cleanup.|边界规则按需求决定；复杂嵌套变简单后仍需验证原行为，不能只追求行数少。~Requirements define boundaries; simplifying nesting still needs behavioral checks, not line-count goals.

structures-cost|序列保留位置和顺序，集合表达不重复成员，映射按键关联值。选择要考虑读取、修改、顺序与规模；复杂度描述增长趋势而非具体耗时。~Sequences model order, sets distinct membership and maps keyed values. Choose by access/update/order/scale; complexity describes growth, not exact runtime.|列主要操作及次数；比较列表查找、集合成员和映射取值；确认重复与顺序语义；用不同规模测量并记录内存与输入分布。~List operations/counts, compare sequence/set/map access, define duplicate/order semantics and measure varied scales with memory/distribution context.|需要去重并保留首次顺序：b,a,b,c。^单用set得到成员但不承诺原顺序；用seen集合配输出列表。^结果b,a,c，二者职责不同。~Deduplicate b,a,b,c preserving first order.^A set tracks membership while an output list preserves order.^Result b,a,c uses both responsibilities.|比较空、重复与大规模输入；核对顺序和成员不变量，而非只比较数量。~Test empty/duplicate/large inputs and assert order/membership, not only count.|Python集合是无序语义；哈希平均复杂度依实现与输入，不能直接承诺固定毫秒。~Python sets have unordered semantics; average hash behavior is not a fixed-millisecond guarantee.

errors|可预期输入错误、外部系统失败与程序缺陷需要不同处理。过宽捕获会把缺陷掩盖成默认成功，缺少上下文则让失败难定位。~Expected input errors, external failures and bugs need different handling. Broad catches can hide defects as successful defaults; missing context impedes diagnosis.|在边界验证输入；捕获能够恢复的具体异常；保留因果上下文并转换为可操作消息；用finally或上下文管理清理资源，避免吞错。~Validate boundaries, catch specific recoverable exceptions, preserve cause/actionable messages and clean resources through finally/context managers.|用户填abc作为整数。^把ValueError转换成字段错误并保留原输入。^若磁盘写入失败，不应也返回“年龄无效”或静默返回0。~abc fails integer parsing.^Map ValueError to a field error while preserving input.^A disk failure must not be mislabeled invalid age or silently return0.|分别注入格式错误、缺资源和系统失败；检查错误类型、清理和无伪成功。~Inject parse/missing-resource/system failures and check classification, cleanup and absence of false success.|异常消息不能泄露秘密；不能用except Exception统一绕过业务失败。~Sanitize errors and do not use broad catches to bypass failed business operations.

unit-tests|单元测试以小边界验证明确行为。可读的前置、动作、断言与具体预期比大量镜像实现的测试更有价值；错误路径也属于契约。~Unit tests verify concrete behavior at small boundaries. Clear setup/action/assertions beat implementation-mirroring checks; errors are part of the contract.|选纯规则或可隔离单元；分别写普通、空、边界与错误输入；给具体期望；控制时间/随机依赖；让失败信息直接说明偏差。~Choose focused units, cover normal/empty/boundary/error contracts and control time/random dependencies with concrete diagnostic expectations.|total([3,7])=10、total([])=0。^两条测试独立断言数值。^如果实现误写len，普通用例失败；只断言“不抛异常”检不出。~total([3,7])=10 andtotal([])=0.^Assert values independently.^A mistakenlen implementation fails the normal case; no-exception assertions miss it.|故意破坏一条规则确认测试能发现；单独与乱序运行保持稳定。~Seed a deliberate rule defect and verify detection, independence and reorder stability.|单元测试不能证明数据库约束或界面焦点；测试边界决定结论范围。~Unit tests do not establish database constraints or UI focus; conclusions follow the tested boundary.

debugging|调试是提出可检验假设并用证据缩小原因。最小复现减少干扰，一次改变多个因素会让“修好了”难以解释；相关性不是根因证明。~Debugging tests hypotheses and narrows causes. Minimal reproductions reduce confounding; simultaneous changes make fixes hard to attribute.|固定版本与输入；复现并缩小；列候选原因与区分实验；每次只改变有意义条件；确认修复后增加回归样例并记录未决问题。~Fix version/input, minimize reproduction and design distinguishing experiments, changing one meaningful factor before regression and documentation.|仅第二次调用返回旧数据。^保留相同输入并分别控制缓存开关，记录读写时点。^若关缓存恢复，还需定位失效逻辑，不能只永久禁用所有缓存结案。~Only the second call returns stale data.^Control caching while logging read/write timing.^Recovery without cache prompts investigation of invalidation, not necessarily permanent global disabling.|在原复现与相邻场景确认；验证假设可被反例推翻；保存输入和版本。~Confirm the original/adjacent cases, use falsifiable hypotheses and retain input/version evidence.|日志可能改变竞态时序；难复现时保留频率和条件，不编造确定原因。~Instrumentation can perturb races; retain frequency/conditions instead of invented certainty.

refactor|重构改变内部结构而保持约定外部行为。修缺陷或改变契约可以同时发生，但应明确区分，避免把行为变化藏在“清理代码”里。~Refactoring changes structure while preserving agreed external behavior. Fixes/contract changes should be explicit rather than hidden as cleanup.|先明确外部契约与回归证据；小步移动职责或消除重复；每步验证；需要改响应类型或默认行为时另列迁移和兼容计划。~Define contracts/regression evidence, make small structural changes and validate each step; plan migrations for type/default changes separately.|把折扣函数拆成计算与格式化。^保持同输入金额、舍入规则与错误一致。^若数字20变字符串'20'，即使显示相同也改变调用契约。~Split discount calculation/formatting.^Preserve amount/rounding/errors.^Number20 becoming string20 changes the contract despite similar display.|比较普通、边界和错误输出；检查调用者、持久格式与性能敏感路径。~Compare normal/boundary/error outputs plus callers, persisted formats and performance-sensitive paths.|没有行为证据时先补关键测试；重构不等于自动改善所有设计或性能。~Add critical evidence when behavior is unprotected; refactoring is not automatic performance/design improvement.

git-branches|分支是可移动引用，合并比较双方与共同祖先。文本无冲突不代表语义无冲突；解决冲突要保留双方业务意图，而不是机械选ours/theirs。~Branches are movable references and merges compare both sides with a common ancestor. Textual merge success does not establish semantic compatibility.|先检查工作区与基线；在可审阅分支记录变更；逐文件理解冲突；消除标记并暂存；运行相关测试后审查完整差异。~Inspect worktree/baseline, record changes on reviewable branches, resolve intent per file and remove markers, stage, test and review the complete diff.|一方给金额加范围校验，另一方改货币精度。^合并需同时保留两条规则。^直接取一方虽然无标记，也可能丢掉另一方修复。~One branch adds amount bounds, another currency precision.^Preserve both rules.^Blindly choosing one side may lose a valid fix despite clean syntax.|查看status、diff与测试结果；确保无冲突标记、无意外文件丢失，合并版本可追溯。~Inspect status/diff/tests and verify no markers or unintended file loss with traceable merge state.|不要为解决冲突重置他人未提交工作；课堂演练应在独立临时仓库，非用户主工程。~Do not reset others' uncommitted work; rehearse in a separate temporary repository.

code-review|审查检查具体变更的正确性、风险、可维护性和验证依据。有效反馈指出触发条件、位置和影响，区分必须修复与可选建议，并给作者可行动的信息。~Review checks correctness/risk/maintainability/evidence. Useful feedback identifies location, trigger and impact while distinguishing blockers from suggestions.|先理解目标与范围；沿数据和控制路径审查；核对边界/错误/权限及测试；对疑点给可定位反馈；修改后复查，不以风格偏好掩盖实质风险。~Understand intent/scope, trace data/control, inspect boundaries/errors/permissions/tests and provide actionable localized feedback, revisiting revisions.|代码把未提供金额默认为0并提交。^反馈指出具体分支、缺失输入与虚假零收入风险，并建议保留未知或拒绝。^“代码太差”没有指导修正的信息。~Missing amounts default to0 and commit.^Point to the branch/input and false-zero risk, suggesting unknown/rejection per contract.^'Bad code' is not actionable.|每条重要反馈有复现条件或规则依据；核对最终差异与检查结果，关闭已解决问题。~Support important comments with triggers/rules and review final diffs/checks before resolution.|审查通过不是无缺陷保证；自动格式化与测试也不能取代业务判断。~Approval is not proof of no defects; formatting/tests do not replace domain judgment.

release-version|发布版本需要关联源码、构建产物、配置与迁移。语义版本表达公共契约变化，分支名或展示版本号本身不能唯一确定服务器正在运行什么。~Releases link source/artifacts/configuration/migrations. Semantic versions describe public-contract changes; branch/display names alone do not identify running content.|写范围及兼容影响；记录提交、依赖锁与产物摘要；列验证、迁移和回退条件；发布后核对实际内容与关键路径，保存回执。~Document scope/compatibility, commit/lock/artifact digests, checks/migrations/recovery gates and post-release receipts.|显示版本1.2.3但服务器静态资源来自另一构建。^对照资源摘要而非只看页脚。^确认真实产物后才能把测试证据关联到上线版本。~A page shows1.2.3 but serves another build's assets.^Compare digests, not only the footer.^Attach verification only after identifying actual deployed content.|比对本地/服务端资源摘要、配置与迁移状态；验收失败时按已验证方案恢复。~Reconcile asset/configuration/migration state and recover through validated plans on failure.|语义版本不能自动保证兼容；回退旧代码前仍要核对数据和外部协议。~SemVer does not automatically ensure compatibility; old code still needs data/protocol compatibility checks.

workflows|现状流程需要区分实际观察、参与者陈述与分析者假设。目标流程应保留角色、输入、决策、例外和交接，而不是只有理想直线步骤。~Distinguish observed workflow, participant reports and analyst assumptions. Target flows include roles, inputs, decisions, exceptions and handoffs rather than only ideal steps.|选一个真实任务类型；按角色画泳道或步骤表；记录等待、审批与返工；标注证据与未知；与执行者核对后设计目标变化。~Select a task, map roles/steps/waits/approvals/rework with evidence/unknowns and validate with practitioners before proposing changes.|报名由学生提交、教务复核，材料缺失会退回。^流程需包含退回修改与再次提交，不只“提交→通过”。^“一天内审核”若只是希望应标目标，不是现状实测。~Students submit, staff review and missing documents return for correction.^Include rework/resubmission.^A hoped-for one-day review is a target, not observed current performance.|让各角色走读正常与例外案例；逐个确认输入、输出、责任与等待依据。~Walk normal/exception cases with roles, validating inputs/outputs/ownership/wait evidence.|访谈记忆可能不完整；没有观察到的次数或耗时不能自动补成事实。~Interviews can be incomplete; unobserved counts/durations must not be invented.

scope-acceptance|范围说明交付什么和明确不交付什么，验收定义谁按什么证据判断满足。需求变化需要评估影响和批准，不能静默修改原基线。~Scope defines delivery/exclusions; acceptance identifies approvers and evidence. Changes require impact review rather than silent baseline edits.|把要求拆为可验证条目；注明约束、排除与依赖；约定验收角色和材料；新增要求登记变更、成本/时间影响与批准后更新基线。~Create verifiable items, constraints/exclusions/dependencies and acceptance ownership/evidence, then review and approve change impacts before baselining.|已批准只读报表，临近上线要求新增编辑。^这是权限与写入范围变化，不是按钮小改。^评估验证、数据和安排影响，获得决定后更新验收。~Approved read-only reporting gains an edit request.^This changes write/permission scope, not only a button.^Assess data/testing/schedule impact before updating acceptance.|用场景核对每个范围条目和排除项；检查批准记录、需求与用例版本一致。~Validate scope/exclusions with scenarios and align approvals, requirements and test versions.|签字不替代实际验证；范围冻结也不意味着忽视发现的关键风险。~Sign-off does not replace verification, and scope freeze does not justify ignoring critical risks.

dependency-owners|依赖就绪需要负责人、到期时间和可核对产物。仅写“等对方处理”无法判断风险或安排升级；依赖链可能影响后续所有验收。~Readiness requires owner, due time and inspectable deliverable. 'Waiting for someone' cannot support risk/escalation decisions; dependencies propagate delays.|列前置任务与外部接口；为每项指定提供方、接收方、期限和证据；设置超期升级与替代方案；就绪后由消费方验证。~List prerequisites/interfaces, assign provider/consumer/date/evidence, define escalation/alternatives and have consumers verify readiness.|上线依赖测试账号和接口白名单。^分别明确账号提供人、批准人、测试证据与最晚时间。^邮件说“已开通”后还需受控连通和权限验证。~Launch needs test accounts and an allowlist.^Assign providers/approvers/evidence/deadlines.^An 'enabled' email still needs controlled connectivity/permission checks.|沿关键路径核对未就绪项；对照证据而非状态口头描述；确认升级联系人可达。~Review unready critical-path items against evidence and reachable escalation contacts.|第三方承诺不是本站已经完成的事实；未知完成时间保持未知并跟进。~External commitments are not completed facts; retain unknown dates explicitly.

environments|环境基线包括软件、配置、依赖、权限和数据来源。测试与生产不仅地址不同，也应隔离凭据与写入范围；可重复配置降低人工漂移。~Baselines include software/configuration/dependencies/permissions/data. Test/production isolation covers credentials/write scope, not only URLs; reproducible configuration limits drift.|登记版本与配置摘要；区分秘密和普通参数；通过模板注入环境差异；以合成数据验证；上线前核对实际基线和未经批准漂移。~Inventory versions/configuration digests, separate secrets, template environment differences and validate with synthetic data before checking actual drift.|测试配置误引用生产写库。^即使页面标“测试”，仍可能修改真实数据。^检查连接目标和最小权限，使测试凭据无法写生产。~A test environment points to a production writable database.^A test label offers no protection.^Validate targets and credentials that cannot write production.|从实际进程配置核对目标，不只读文档；检查版本、权限及关键路径。~Inspect actual process configuration, not only documents, and verify versions/permissions/paths.|环境相似不代表所有差异消除；不要把真实秘密复制进交接文档或教学材料。~Environment parity has limits; never copy real secrets into handover or teaching material.

role-matrix|角色权限矩阵把岗位职责映射到资源与动作。允许与拒绝都需验证；权限变更、离岗和临时授权需要生命周期，而不只是一次开账号。~Access matrices map duties to resource/actions. Verify allow/deny paths and lifecycle changes for role changes, departures and temporary grants.|按职责列最小权限；注明资源范围与审批；建立允许和拒绝案例；上线复核账号映射；规定到期、撤销与定期审查。~Define minimum scoped permissions/approval, allow/deny cases and account mapping, with expiry/revocation/review policies.|客服可读本人分配工单，不可改付款信息。^验证可读所分工单、拒绝他人工单及付款修改。^只检查能登录不能完成权限验收。~Support reads assigned tickets but cannot edit payments.^Test assigned reads and denial of others/payment edits.^Login success is insufficient acceptance.|用不同角色和对象走矩阵；检查批量、导出、撤销后会话和默认拒绝。~Exercise roles/objects, bulk/export/revoked sessions and default denial.|角色名不是权限事实；具体系统可能还有数据域、组织层级与继承规则。~Role names do not prove permissions; systems can add data scopes, hierarchy and inheritance.

migration|迁移把来源字段与目标语义对应，完整性、唯一性与业务总量都需对账。失败清单解释差额，但不能代替抽样内容与主键关系检查。~Migration maps field semantics and reconciles completeness, keys and business totals. Failure lists explain differences but do not replace content/reference checks.|定义映射、类型、时区与冲突规则；小范围试迁；保留成功/失败键及原因；对账计数、金额、引用和样本；修正后按稳定键重试并验收。~Specify mapping/types/zones/conflicts, trial a small scope and retain successful/failed keys, reconciling counts/totals/references/samples before idempotent retries.|源50行金额900，成功48行850，失败2行50。^行与金额均能解释，但仍检查两条失败能否修正且不重复插入成功行。^计数相等不保证字段含义相同。~Source50/900, success48/850, failures2/50.^Counts/totals reconcile, but repair/retry failures without duplicating successes.^Equal counts do not establish semantic correctness.|双向核对键、总量、映射样本和失败重试；将验收与最终实际版本关联。~Check keys both ways, totals, mapped samples and retry behavior against the final version.|真实迁移涉及授权、备份和回退，课堂只用合成材料；未知数据不随意补零通过对账。~Real migration needs authority/backups/recovery; exercises use synthetic data and preserve unknowns.

uat|用户验收由代表性业务角色按实际任务判断适用性，技术测试提供支持但不能替代角色使用。缺陷、剩余风险与批准结论需分别留证。~Representative users assess fitness through tasks; technical checks support but do not replace this. Preserve defects/residual risks and approval separately.|选关键角色与任务；准备近真实的合成数据和环境；明确验收标准；让用户执行并记录实际结果、问题和决定；修复后复核受影响任务。~Select roles/tasks, realistic synthetic data/environment and criteria; record user execution, findings/decisions and retest affected tasks.|财务角色需核对月结并导出。^让该角色走筛选、对账、导出与拒绝越权，记录产物。^开发者演示一张成功截图不能宣称UAT完成。~Finance needs reconciliation/export.^Have that role execute filters/totals/export/denials with artifacts.^One developer demo screenshot is not completedUAT.|对照角色、任务、环境与签收证据；检查未通过和未执行项没有被合并隐藏。~Reconcile role/task/environment/sign-off evidence and keep failed/untested items visible.|签收可有条件或延期，必须写清剩余风险；参与人数不能代替任务覆盖。~Acceptance can be conditional/deferred with explicit risk; attendee counts do not establish task coverage.

cutover|切换是一组有顺序、责任和判断条件的动作，冻结、备份、迁移、路由切换与验证互相依赖。步骤完成不等于已满足继续下一步的门槛。~Cutover orders owned actions and criteria across freeze/backup/migration/routing/verification. Completing a command does not automatically satisfy the next gate.|编排时间线与依赖；给每步负责人、输入、成功证据和停止/回退条件；先演练耗时与恢复；执行中记录实况并按门槛推进。~Plan dependencies/timeline, owners/inputs/evidence/stop conditions, rehearse duration/recovery and advance only through recorded gates.|迁移计数不符，但切换时间已到。^按门槛暂停，保留旧系统服务或批准的恢复路径。^不能为按时切换而把未解释差额标通过。~Migration counts disagree at the planned switch time.^Pause under the gate and preserve the old service/recovery option.^Do not relabel unexplained gaps to meet the schedule.|逐步核对回执、依赖和业务路径；演练失败发生在不同阶段的处置。~Review receipts/dependencies/user paths and rehearse failures at multiple stages.|演练环境与生产规模差异需说明；回退数据与代码可能有不同条件。~Disclose rehearsal/production scale differences; data and code rollback have different prerequisites.

go-no-go|上线决定依据预先约定门槛与可接受剩余风险，不是平均通过率投票。关键缺陷、不可恢复迁移或责任未落实都可能独立阻断。~Launch decisions use predefined gates and acceptable residual risk, not average pass-rate voting. Critical defects/recovery gaps/ownership can independently block.|预先定义必须条件、容忍项和批准人；汇总实际证据及未测范围；逐门槛判断；记录决定、理由和回退触发，不临时降低门槛掩盖问题。~Define mandatory/tolerable conditions and approvers, collect evidence/gaps and decide per gate with rationale/recovery triggers, without quietly lowering standards.|用例通过98%，但关键支付重复扣款未修。^若门槛要求关键缺陷为零，则no-go。^剩余2%不能只按数量解释，需看风险与可恢复性。~98% of cases pass but duplicate charging remains.^A zero-critical-defect gate yieldsno-go.^Risk/recoverability matter more than the count of remaining cases.|检查每个门槛对应当前版本证据；区分批准例外与未获批准的缺口。~Trace each gate to current-version evidence and distinguish approved exceptions from unresolved gaps.|批准也不改变已观察事实；上线后仍需监测及真实恢复能力。~Approval does not change observed facts; post-launch monitoring and recovery remain necessary.

role-training|培训目标是角色能够完成具体任务，而不是看完材料。示范、跟练、独立操作和反馈逐步减少帮助，留下能观察的结果与待补项。~Training aims at role-specific task performance, not content consumption. Demonstration/guided/independent work and feedback progressively remove support.|按角色选择任务；提供示范与练习材料；跟练时解释判断；独立阶段减少提示；按明确标准观察结果，收集问题并安排复练。~Select role tasks, demonstrate with materials/reasoning, guide then reduce hints, observing independent outcomes against criteria and scheduling targeted practice.|客服学习新建并升级工单。^先示范普通与高风险单，再给不同情境独立处理。^记录字段、路由与升级依据，不能只记到场。~Support learns ticket creation/escalation.^Demonstrate normal/high-risk cases, then use different independent scenarios.^Record fields/routing/rationale, not only attendance.|核对任务结果、帮助程度与错误反馈；让学习者说明为何升级及何时不能自行处理。~Assess outputs, assistance and feedback, including escalation rationale/limits.|一次练习通过不等于长期熟练；角色权限和真实环境变化需要更新训练。~One successful practice is not lasting proficiency; update training with roles/environments.

support-triage|报障分诊先看影响、紧迫性和可用绕过，再收集可复现证据。严重度与服务响应约定决定升级，不应把所有工单按先来后到处理。~Triage considers impact/urgency/workarounds and reproducible evidence. Severity/service agreements govern escalation, not simply arrival order.|记录受影响角色、范围、开始时间、版本与近期变化；收集最小复现和错误证据；分类、给临时建议、指定负责人及下一更新；按门槛升级。~Capture users/scope/start/version/changes and minimal reproduction, then classify, advise, assign ownership/update time and escalate by criteria.|全部用户不能提交且无绕过；另一单只有一人样式错位。^通常前者更紧急，先确认范围并升级。^仍按明确服务约定，不从截图外观猜影响。~All users cannot submit with no workaround; another has one cosmetic issue.^The former generally needs faster confirmation/escalation.^Use service criteria rather than visual severity guesses.|检查分类依据、证据完整性与更新履约；核对恢复后用户实际路径。~Review classification/evidence/update commitments and restored user workflows.|不要在工单索取真实密码或令牌；信息不足时标未知并定向补问。~Do not request passwords/tokens; keep unknowns explicit and gather targeted evidence.

handoff|移交同时交付可用知识、访问申请方式和未决责任。文档清单齐全不代表接收方能独立操作；需要走读、演练与确认剩余事项。~Handover transfers usable knowledge/access processes/open ownership. A document checklist does not establish independent operation; walkthroughs/rehearsals expose gaps.|整理环境、版本、手册、恢复、权限申请与已知问题；由接收方复做关键任务；将未决项指定负责人、到期与升级；约定过渡支持和更新时间。~Compile environment/version/runbooks/recovery/access/open issues, have recipients perform key tasks and assign follow-up owners/dates/escalation and transition support.|交付手册但缺少备份恢复负责人。^补责任与受控演练依据，由支持方确认入口可用。^未演练的恢复应标未验证，不能因文档存在而关闭。~A runbook lacks backup-recovery ownership.^Assign it and validate controlled rehearsal/access with the support team.^Mark untested recovery as unverified despite documentation.|让接收方查找故障、申请权限并走读恢复；检查每个未决项有可追踪责任。~Have recipients locate faults/request access/walk recovery and check traceable ownership for every open issue.|交接不传播真实秘密；支持期结束与责任转移要明确，不能只写“后续联系开发”。~Do not transfer secrets in documentation; define transition dates and responsibility beyond vague developer contact.
